        notifAdminId,
        `New Teacher Registration: ${fullName}`,
        `${fullName} (${email}, Department: ${department}) has registered and requires Super Admin approval.`,
        notifInchargeId,
        `New Teacher Registration: ${fullName}`,
        `${fullName} (${email}, Department: ${department}) has registered for laboratory practical access.`,
      ]
    )

    await client.end()

    return {
      success: true,
      pendingApproval: true,
      message: 'Your account is pending Super Admin approval. Please await administrator verification.',
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { error: err.message || 'Failed to complete registration.' }
  }
}

// 3. Sign Out Action
export async function signOut() {
  invalidateUserProfileCache()
  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
  }
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
  redirect('/login')
}

// 4. Get Current User Profile with Permissions
export async function getCurrentUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE)
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    return {
      id: 'local-admin',
      email: 'admin@rrl.edu.np',
      full_name: 'System Administrator',
      role: 'super_admin',
      department: 'Central Administration',
      is_active: true,
      permissions: DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.super_admin,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
  }

  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

    if (!user) return null

    // Check in-memory cache
    const cached = userProfileCache.get(user.id)
    if (cached && Date.now() - cached.timestamp < 30000) {
      return cached.profile
    }

    const { data: profile, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', user.id)
      .single()

    let result: UserProfile

    if (error || !profile) {
      const metaRole = (user.user_metadata?.role as UserRole) || 'teacher'
      result = {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        full_name: user.user_metadata?.full_name || user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Teacher',
        role: metaRole,
        department: user.user_metadata?.department || 'Science Department',
        photo_url: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || user.user_metadata?.photo_url || null,
        avatar_url: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || user.user_metadata?.photo_url || null,
        is_active: true,
        permissions: DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[metaRole] || DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.teacher,
        created_at: user.created_at,
      }
    } else {
      const typedProfile = profile as any
      const finalRole: UserRole =
        typedProfile.role === 'admin' ? 'super_admin' : typedProfile.role || 'teacher'

      result = {
        id: typedProfile.id,
        email: typedProfile.email || user.email,
        phone: typedProfile.phone || null,
        full_name: typedProfile.full_name,
        role: finalRole,
        department: typedProfile.department,
        photo_url: typedProfile.photo_url || typedProfile.avatar_url || null,
        avatar_url: typedProfile.avatar_url || typedProfile.photo_url || null,
        is_active: typedProfile.is_active ?? true,
        permissions: typedProfile.permissions || DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[finalRole],
        created_at: typedProfile.created_at,
      }
    }

    userProfileCache.set(user.id, { profile: result, timestamp: Date.now() })
    return result
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      id: 'local-user',
      email: 'teacher@rrl.edu.np',
      full_name: 'Class Teacher',
      role: 'teacher',
      department: 'Science Department',
      photo_url: null,
      avatar_url: null,
      is_active: true,
      permissions: DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS.teacher,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }
  }
}

// 5. SUPER ADMIN: Get All Users
export async function getAllUsers(): Promise<UserProfile[]> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged) {
      return []
    }

    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, email, phone, full_name, role, department, photo_url, avatar_url, is_active, approval_status, permissions, created_at
      FROM public.profiles
      ORDER BY created_at DESC;
    `)

    return res.rows.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      email: row.email,
      phone: row.phone || null,
      full_name: row.full_name,
      role: row.role === 'admin' ? 'super_admin' : row.role,
      department: row.department,
      photo_url: row.photo_url || row.avatar_url || null,
      avatar_url: row.avatar_url || row.photo_url || null,
      is_active: row.is_active ?? true,
      approval_status: row.approval_status || 'approved',
      permissions: row.permissions || DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[row.role as UserRole],
      created_at: row.created_at,
    }))
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to get users:', err)
    return []
  }
}

// 6. SUPER ADMIN: Create New User Account (Teacher, Incharge, HOD, Admin)
export async function createUserAccount(data: {
  full_name: string
  email: string
  phone?: string
  password: string
  role: UserRole
  department?: string
  photo_url?: string
  permissions?: UserPermissions
}) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (scope.role !== 'super_admin') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can create user accounts with assigned institutional roles.',
    }
  }

  const email = data.email.trim().toLowerCase()
  const phone = data.phone?.trim() || null
  const password = data.password
  const fullName = data.full_name.trim()
  const role = data.role
  const department = data.department?.trim() || 'Science Department'
  const permissions = data.permissions || DEFAULT_ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role]

  try {
    const client = getPgClient()
    await client.connect()

    // 🛡️ Double User Added Protection: check email duplicate
    const checkEmail = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM auth.users WHERE email = $1`, [email])
    if (checkEmail.rows.length > 0) {
      await client.end()
      return { success: false, error: `An account with email "${email}" already exists. Duplicate accounts are prohibited.` }
    }

    // 🛡️ Double User Added Protection: check phone duplicate if provided
    if (phone) {
      const checkPhone = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE phone = $1`, [phone])
      if (checkPhone.rows.length > 0) {
        await client.end()
        return { success: false, error: `An account with phone number "${phone}" is already registered in the system.` }
      }
    }

    const userRes = await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO auth.users (
        instance_id,
        id,
        aud,
        role,
        email,
        encrypted_password,
        email_confirmed_at,
        raw_app_meta_data,
        raw_user_meta_data,
        confirmation_token,
        recovery_token,
        email_change_token_new,
        email_change,
        is_sso_user,
        is_anonymous,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid,
        gen_random_uuid(),
        'authenticated',
        'authenticated',
        $1,
        crypt($2, gen_salt('bf', 10)),
        now(),
        '{"provider": "email", "providers": ["email"]}'::jsonb,
        jsonb_build_object('full_name', $3::text, 'role', $4::text, 'department', $5::text, 'email_verified', true),
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        false,
        false,
        now(),
        now()
      ) RETURNING id;
      `,
      [email, password, fullName, role, department]
    )

    const userId = userRes.rows[0].id

    // Insert identity
    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO auth.identities (
        id,
        user_id,
        identity_data,
        provider,
        provider_id,
        last_sign_in_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        gen_random_uuid(),
        $1::uuid,
        jsonb_build_object('sub', $1::text, 'email', $2::text, 'email_verified', true, 'phone_verified', false),
        'email',
        $1::text,
        now(),
        now(),
        now()
      );
      `,
      [userId, email]
    )

    // Insert profile with phone number and optional photo
    await client.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO public.profiles (
        id,
        email,
        phone,
        full_name,
        role,
        department,
        photo_url,
        avatar_url,
        is_active,
        permissions,
        created_at
      ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $7, true, $8, now());
      `,
      [userId, email, phone, fullName, role, department, data.photo_url || null, JSON.stringify(permissions)]
    )

    await client.end()

    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'CREATE',
      entityType: 'user_role',
      entityId: userId,
      entityLabel: `${fullName} (${role.toUpperCase()})`,
      after: {
        email,
        phone,
        full_name: fullName,
        role,
        department,
        permissions,
        password, // Redacted automatically by lib/audit.ts
      },
      metadata: { operation: 'create_user_account' },
    })

    revalidatePath('/admin')
    return { success: true, userId }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error creating user account:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to create user account.' }
  }
}

// 7. SUPER ADMIN: Update User Credentials (Password, Email, Phone, Name, Role, Dept, Photo)
export async function updateUserCredentials(
  userId: string,
  data: {
    full_name?: string
    email?: string
    phone?: string
    new_password?: string
    role?: UserRole
    department?: string
    photo_url?: string | null
    avatar_url?: string | null
  }
) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (scope.role !== 'super_admin') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can modify credentials and user roles.',
    }
  }

  try {
    const client = getPgClient()
    await client.connect()

    // 🛡️ Pre-query profile state for audit diff
    const prevProfileRes = await client.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name, email, phone, role, department, photo_url FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid`,
      [userId]
    )
    const beforeProfile = prevProfileRes.rows[0] || null

    if (data.new_password && data.new_password.trim().length >= 6) {
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE auth.users 
        SET encrypted_password = crypt($1, gen_salt('bf', 10)),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $2::uuid;
        `,
        [data.new_password.trim(), userId]
      )
    }

    if (data.email) {
      const cleanEmail = data.email.trim().toLowerCase()
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE auth.users 
        SET email = $1,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $2::uuid;
        `,
        [cleanEmail, userId]
      )

      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE auth.identities
        SET identity_data = jsonb_build_object('sub', $1::text, 'email', $2::text, 'email_verified', true, 'phone_verified', false),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE user_id = $1::uuid AND provider = 'email';
        `,
        [userId, cleanEmail]
      )
    }

    // 🛡️ Double User Added Protection: check phone duplicate if provided
    if (data.phone !== undefined) {
      const phone = data.phone.trim()
      if (phone) {
        const checkPhone = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE phone = $1 AND id != $2::uuid`, [phone, userId])
        if (checkPhone.rows.length > 0) {
          await client.end()
          throw new Error(`An account with phone number "${phone}" is already registered in the system.`)
        }
      }
    }

    // Update profile
    const updates: string[] = []
    const params: any[] = [userId]
    let paramIdx = 2

    if (data.full_name) {
      updates.push(`full_name = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.full_name.trim())
    }
    if (data.email) {
      updates.push(`email = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.email.trim().toLowerCase())
    }
    if (data.phone !== undefined) {
      updates.push(`phone = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.phone?.trim() || null)
    }
    if (data.role) {
      updates.push(`role = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.role)
    }
    if (data.department) {
      updates.push(`department = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.department.trim())
    }
    if (data.photo_url !== undefined) {
      updates.push(`photo_url = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.photo_url || null)
      updates.push(`avatar_url = $${paramIdx++}`)
      params.push(data.photo_url || null)
    }

    if (updates.length > 0) {
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE public.profiles
        SET ${updates.join(', ')}
        WHERE id = $1::uuid;
        `,
        params
      )
    }

    await client.end()

    userProfileCache.delete(userId)

    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      entityType: 'user_role',
      entityId: userId,
      entityLabel: beforeProfile?.full_name ? `${beforeProfile.full_name} (${(data.role || beforeProfile.role).toUpperCase()})` : userId,
      before: beforeProfile,
      after: {
        ...beforeProfile,
        ...data,
        ...(data.new_password ? { new_password: data.new_password } : {}), // redacted automatically
      },
      metadata: { operation: 'update_user_credentials' },
    })

    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error updating user credentials:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to update credentials.' }
  }
}

// 7b. Self-Service: Update Current Logged-in User's Profile Photo
export async function updateCurrentUserPhoto(photoUrl: string | null) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (!scope.userId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active user session found.' }
  }

  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET photo_url = $1,
          avatar_url = $1
      WHERE id = $2::uuid;
      `,
      [photoUrl || null, scope.userId]
    )

    userProfileCache.delete(scope.userId)

    revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error updating current user photo:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to update profile photo.' }
  }
}

  }
}

// 10. SUPER ADMIN: Delete User Account
export async function deleteUserAccount(userId: string) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (scope.role !== 'super_admin') {
    return { success: false, error: 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can delete user accounts.' }
  }

  try {
    const client = getPgClient()
    await client.connect()

    const prevRes = await client.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name, email, role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`,
      [userId]
    )
    const beforeProfile = prevRes.rows[0] || null

    if (!beforeProfile) {
      await client.end()
      return { success: false, error: 'User account not found.' }
    }

    // Safety guard: Protect root super administrator
    if (beforeProfile.role === 'super_admin' && beforeProfile.email === 'admin@rrl.edu.np') {
      await client.end()
      return { success: false, error: 'The primary Super Administrator account cannot be deleted.' }
    }

    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN')

      // Pre-nullify references to prevent foreign key constraint violations
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.maintenance_logs SET performed_by_id = NULL WHERE performed_by_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.institution_settings SET updated_by = NULL WHERE updated_by = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.schedules SET teacher_id = NULL WHERE teacher_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.practical_logs SET teacher_id = NULL WHERE teacher_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.lab_incidents SET reported_by_id = NULL WHERE reported_by_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.lab_incidents SET resolved_by_id = NULL WHERE resolved_by_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.maintenance_plans SET assigned_user_id = NULL WHERE assigned_user_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.teacher_substitutions WHERE original_teacher_id = $1 OR substitute_teacher_id = $1`, [userId])

      // Delete from public.profiles
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`, [userId])

      // Cascade deletes in auth identities, sessions, and users
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.identities WHERE user_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.sessions WHERE user_id = $1`, [userId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1`, [userId])

      await client.query('COMMIT')
    } catch (dbErr) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      throw dbErr
    } finally {
      await client.end()
    }

    await invalidateUserProfileCache(userId)

    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'DELETE',
      entityType: 'user_role',
      entityId: userId,
      entityLabel: beforeProfile?.full_name ? `${beforeProfile.full_name} (${beforeProfile.role.toUpperCase()})` : userId,
      before: beforeProfile,
      metadata: { operation: 'delete_user_account' },
    })

    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[DATABASE ERROR] Error deleting user account:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to delete user account.' }
  }
}

// 11. SUPER ADMIN: Approve User Account
export async function approveUserAccount(userId: string) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (scope.role !== 'super_admin') {
    return { success: false, error: 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can approve user accounts.' }
  }

  try {
    const client = getPgClient()
    await client.connect()

    const res = await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET approval_status = 'approved',
          is_active = TRUE
      WHERE id = $1
      RETURNING email, full_name, role;
      `,
      [userId]
    )

    await client.end()

    if (res.rows.length > 0) {
      const user = res.rows[0]
      if (user.email) {
        sendAccountApprovedEmail(user.email, user.full_name).catch(() => {})
      }

      await recordAuditEvent({
        action: 'UPDATE',
        entityType: 'user_role',
        entityId: userId,
        entityLabel: `${user.full_name} (${user.role?.toUpperCase() || 'STAFF'})`,
        before: { approval_status: 'pending', is_active: false },
        after: { approval_status: 'approved', is_active: true },
        metadata: { operation: 'approve_user_account' },
      })
    }

    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/', 'layout')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Failed to approve user:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to approve account.' }
  }
}

// 12. SUPER ADMIN: Reject User Account
export async function rejectUserAccount(userId: string) {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  if (scope.role !== 'super_admin') {
    return { success: false, error: 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can reject user accounts.' }
  }

  try {
    const client = getPgClient()
    await client.connect()

    const prevRes = await client.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name, email, role, approval_status FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`,
      [userId]
    )
    const beforeUser = prevRes.rows[0] || null

    await client.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET approval_status = 'rejected',
          is_active = FALSE
      WHERE id = $1;
      `,
      [userId]
    )

    await client.end()

    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      entityType: 'user_role',
      entityId: userId,
      entityLabel: beforeUser?.full_name ? `${beforeUser.full_name} (${beforeUser.role?.toUpperCase() || 'STAFF'})` : userId,

'use server'

import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'
import type { ClassRecord, ClassEnrollmentStat } from '@/lib/types/classes'

/**
 * Returns a map of class_id -> active enrolled student count for the given academic year.
 * Executes a single, fast aggregated GROUP BY query to eliminate the N+1 query problem.
 */
export async function getClassEnrollmentStats(
  academicYearId?: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: Record<string, number>; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    let effectiveYearId = academicYearId
    if (!effectiveYearId) {
      const yearRes = await pool.query(
        `SELECT id FROM public.academic_years WHERE is_current = true LIMIT 1;`
      )
      effectiveYearId = yearRes.rows[0]?.id || '2083'
    }
    const query = `
      SELECT 
        class_id, 
        count(*)::int AS enrolled_count
      FROM public.student_enrollments
      WHERE academic_year_id = $1 
        AND status = 'active'
      GROUP BY class_id;
    `
    const res = await pool.query(query, [effectiveYearId])

    const statsMap: Record<string, number> = {}
    for (const row of res.rows) {
      statsMap[row.class_id] = row.enrolled_count
      const norm = row.class_id.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s-_]/g, '')
      statsMap[norm] = row.enrolled_count
    }

    return { success: true, data: statsMap }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'
    console.error('Failed to get class enrollment stats:', msg)
    return { success: false, data: {}, error: msg }
  }
}

/**
 * Returns all active classes directly from public.classes database table.
 * Strictly dynamic single source of truth.
 */
export async function getClassesAction(): Promise<{
  success: boolean
  data: ClassRecord[]
  error?: string
}> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const query = `
      SELECT id, name, grade, section, stream_id, capacity, is_active, created_at
      FROM public.classes
      WHERE is_active = true
      ORDER BY grade DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC;
    `
    const res = await pool.query(query)
    return {
      success: true,
      data: res.rows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        name: r.name,
        grade: r.grade,
        section: r.section,
        stream_id: r.stream_id,
        capacity: Number(r.capacity || 40),
        is_active: Boolean(r.is_active),
        created_at: r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toISOString() : undefined,
      })),
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'
    console.error('Failed to get classes from database:', msg)
    return { success: false, data: [], error: msg }
  }
}

/**
 * Returns all active physical floor landmarks (whiteboards, doors, podiums, racks) for a room.
 */
export async function getLabFloorElements(
  labId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data: LabFloorElementRow[]; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged && !scope.assignedLabIds.includes(labId)) {
      return { success: false, data: [], error: 'Access denied: You do not have permission to view this lab floor layout.' }
    }

    const supabase = await createClient()
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('lab_floor_elements')
      .select('*')
      .eq('lab_id', labId)
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })

    if (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching lab floor elements:', error)
      return { success: false, data: [], error: 'Failed to retrieve floor landmarks.' }
    }

    return { success: true, data: (data || []) as LabFloorElementRow[] }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'
    return { success: false, data: [], error: msg }
  }
}

/**
 * Saves/updates physical floor landmarks in batch. Privileged users only.
 */
export async function saveLabFloorElements(
  labId: string,
  elements: LabFloorElementInput[]
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Access denied: Only administrators can modify physical room landmarks.' }
    }

    // Validate coordinates
    for (const el of elements) {
      if (!validateFloorCoordinates(el.pos_x, el.pos_y)) {
        return { success: false, error: `Invalid coordinates for landmark "${el.label}": positions must be between 0% and 100%.` }
      }
    }

    const supabase = await createClient()

    // Upsert elements
    for (const el of elements) {
      const { x, y } = clampFloorCoordinates(el.pos_x, el.pos_y)

      if (el.id) {
        await supabase
          .from('lab_floor_elements')
          .update({
            element_type: el.element_type,
            label: el.label.trim(),
            pos_x: x,
            pos_y: y,
            width: el.width || 12.0,
            height: el.height || 4.0,
            rotation: el.rotation || 0,
            metadata: el.metadata || {},
            is_active: el.is_active !== undefined ? el.is_active : true,
          })
          .eq('id', el.id)
      } else {
        await supabase
          .from('lab_floor_elements')
          .insert({
            lab_id: labId,
            element_type: el.element_type,
            label: el.label.trim(),
            pos_x: x,
            pos_y: y,
            width: el.width || 12.0,
            height: el.height || 4.0,
            rotation: el.rotation || 0,
            metadata: el.metadata || {},
            is_active: true,
          })
      }
    }

    revalidatePath('/maintenance', 'layout')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'
    return { success: false, error: msg }
  }
}

export async function getAcademicHolidays(): Promise<HolidayItem[]> {

    return cachedHolidays.data
  }

  if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) {

  }

  try {
    const supabase = await createClient()
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('academic_holidays')
      .select('*')
      .order('date_start', { ascending: true })

    if (error || !data || data.length === 0) {
      return DEFAULT_HOLIDAYS
    }

    const mapped = data.map((row: any) => ({
      id: row.id,
      title: row.title,
      name: row.name || row.title,
      titleNp: row.title_np,
      dateStr: row.date_start,
      endDateStr: row.date_end || row.date_start,
      bsDateStr: row.bs_date_str,
      type: row.holiday_type || 'cultural',
      description: row.description,
    }))

    cachedHolidays = { data: mapped, timestamp: Date.now() }
    return mapped
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[LMR] Failed to fetch academic holidays from Supabase, using default fallback:', err)
    return DEFAULT_HOLIDAYS
  }
}

export async function reportIncident(data: Omit<LabIncidentRecord, 'id' | 'created_at' | 'status' | 'escalated_to_hod'> & { id?: string; reported_by_id?: string | null; resolved_by_id?: string | null; fine_paid?: boolean; photo_url?: string | null }): Promise<{ success: boolean; incident?: LabIncidentRecord; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const recordId = data.id || `inc-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`
    const isCritical = data.severity === 'major_critical'
    const validReportedById = isValidUuid(data.reported_by_id) ? data.reported_by_id : null
    const validResolvedById = isValidUuid(data.resolved_by_id) ? data.resolved_by_id : null

    const newRecord: LabIncidentRecord = {
      ...data,
      id: recordId,
      photo_url: data.photo_url || null,
      status: isCritical ? 'escalated_to_hod' : 'reported',
      escalated_to_hod: isCritical,
      escalation_reason: isCritical ? (data.escalation_reason || 'Critical equipment damage requiring immediate institutional inspection') : null,
      escalated_at: isCritical ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
      fine_paid: Boolean(data.fine_paid),
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reported_by_id: validReportedById,
    }

    // 1. Shared in-memory store (deduplicated by ID)
    const store = getIncStore()
    const existingIdx = store.findIndex((i) => i.id === recordId)
    if (existingIdx !== -1) {
      store[existingIdx] = newRecord
    } else {
      store.unshift(newRecord)
    }

    // Auto-generate notifications for roles
    const notifStore = getNotifStore()
    // Clean up any existing notifications for this incident to prevent duplicate alerts
    for (let i = notifStore.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (notifStore[i].incident_id === recordId) {
        notifStore.splice(i, 1)
      }
    }

    const labName =
      data.lab_id === 'chem'
        ? 'Chemistry Laboratory'
        : data.lab_id === 'phys'
        ? 'Physics Laboratory'
        : data.lab_id === 'comp'
        ? 'Computer Laboratory'
        : `${data.lab_id.toUpperCase()} Lab`

    const notifsToInsert: LabNotificationRecord[] = [
      {
        id: `notif-${recordId}-admin`,
        incident_id: recordId,
        target_role: 'super_admin',
        target_lab_id: data.lab_id,
        title: `${isCritical ? '🚨 CRITICAL: ' : ''}${data.title}`,
        message: `${labName}: Reported by ${data.reported_by} during ${data.session_label} (${data.batch_name}). ${data.circumstances || ''}`,
        severity: isCritical ? 'critical' : data.severity === 'moderate' ? 'warning' : 'info',
        is_read: false,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      {
        id: `notif-${recordId}-incharge`,
        incident_id: recordId,
        target_role: 'lab_incharge',
        target_lab_id: data.lab_id,
        title: `Damage Reported in ${data.lab_id.toUpperCase()} Lab`,
        message: `${data.title} (${data.batch_name} • ${data.session_label}). Assigned to Lab In-Charge for repair or replacement triage.`,
        severity: isCritical ? 'critical' : data.severity === 'moderate' ? 'warning' : 'info',
        is_read: false,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    ]

    // If critical or moderate, notify HOD as well
    if (isCritical || data.severity === 'moderate') {
      notifsToInsert.push({
        id: `notif-${recordId}-hod`,
        incident_id: recordId,
        target_role: 'hod',
        target_lab_id: data.lab_id,
        title: `${isCritical ? '🚨 HOD ESCALATION: ' : 'HOD Notice: '}${data.title}`,
        message: `${labName}: ${data.batch_name} practical session damage reported. ${isCritical ? 'Immediate Head review and directive required.' : 'Logged in institutional register.'}`,
        severity: isCritical ? 'critical' : 'warning',
        is_read: false,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
    }

    notifsToInsert.forEach((n) => notifStore.unshift(n))

    // 3. Dual-Write to Supabase if configured (for realtime subscriptions)
    if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
      try {
        const supabase = await createClient()
        await (supabase.from('lab_incidents') as any).upsert({
          ...newRecord,
          reported_by_id: validReportedById,
          resolved_by_id: validResolvedById,
        }, { onConflict: 'id' })

        // Clear prior notifications if any and insert fresh notifications
        await (supabase.from('lab_notifications') as any).delete().eq('incident_id', recordId)
        await (supabase.from('lab_notifications') as any).insert(notifsToInsert)
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Supabase incident insert fallback active:', err)
      }
    }

    // 4. Exhaustive cache revalidation across all related routes
    revalidatePath('/records/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/records')
    revalidatePath('/print/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/schedules')
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/')

    // Non-blocking background email dispatch with Next.js after()
    after(async () => {
      await dispatchIncidentEmailAlert(newRecord, false).catch((err) =>
        console.error('[Mailer] Background incident alert failed:', err)
      )
    })

    return { success: true, incident: newRecord }
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message || 'Failed to report incident' }
  }
}

export async function escalateIncidentToHOD(id: string, reason: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const store = getIncStore()
    const item = store.find((i) => i.id === id)
    if (!item) return { success: false, error: 'Incident record not found' }

    const now = new Date().toISOString()
    item.status = 'escalated_to_hod'
    item.escalated_to_hod = true
    item.escalation_reason = reason
    item.escalated_at = now

    // Create high-priority HOD notification
    const notifStore = getNotifStore()
    const hodNotif: LabNotificationRecord = {
      id: `notif-${id}-hod-esc`,
      incident_id: id,
      target_role: 'hod',
      target_lab_id: item.lab_id,
      title: `⚡ HOD Escalation: ${item.equipment_name} Issue`,
      message: `Escalated for HOD Intervention: "${reason}". Session: ${item.session_label} (${item.batch_name}).`,
      severity: 'critical',
      is_read: false,
      created_at: now,
    }

    // Clean up any prior escalation notif
    for (let i = notifStore.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (notifStore[i].id === hodNotif.id) {
        notifStore.splice(i, 1)
      }
    }
    notifStore.unshift(hodNotif)

    if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
      try {
        const supabase = await createClient()
        await (supabase.from('lab_incidents') as any).update({
          status: 'escalated_to_hod',
          escalated_to_hod: true,
          escalation_reason: reason,
          escalated_at: now,
        }).eq('id', id)
        await (supabase.from('lab_notifications') as any).delete().eq('id', hodNotif.id)
        await (supabase.from('lab_notifications') as any).insert([hodNotif])
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    revalidatePath('/records/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/records')
    revalidatePath('/print/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/')

    // Non-blocking background email dispatch with Next.js after()
    after(async () => {
      await dispatchIncidentEmailAlert(item, true).catch((err) =>
        console.error('[Mailer] Background HOD escalation alert failed:', err)
      )
    })

    return { success: true }
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message }
  }
}

export async function updateIncidentStatus(
  id: string,
  data: {
    status: 'under_repair' | 'replaced' | 'resolved'
    resolution_notes?: string
    resolved_by: string
    fine_paid?: boolean
    fine_receipt_no?: string
  }
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const store = getIncStore()
    const idx = store.findIndex((i) => i.id === id)
    const now = new Date().toISOString()
    if (idx !== -1) {
      store[idx] = {
        ...store[idx],
        status: data.status,
        resolution_notes: data.resolution_notes || store[idx].resolution_notes,
        resolved_by: data.resolved_by,
        resolved_at: now,
        fine_paid: typeof data.fine_paid === 'boolean' ? data.fine_paid : store[idx].fine_paid,
        fine_receipt_no: data.fine_receipt_no || store[idx].fine_receipt_no,
      }
    }

    if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
      try {
        const supabase = await createClient()
        await (supabase.from('lab_incidents') as any).update({
          status: data.status,
          resolution_notes: data.resolution_notes,
          resolved_by: data.resolved_by,
          resolved_at: now,
          fine_paid: data.fine_paid,
          fine_receipt_no: data.fine_receipt_no,
        }).eq('id', id)
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    revalidatePath('/records/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/records')
    revalidatePath('/print/incidents')
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/')

    return { success: true }
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message }
  }
}

export async function getIncidents(filters?: {
  lab_id?: string
  status?: string
  severity?: string
  date?: string
  view_mode?: 'my_data' | 'all'
}): Promise<LabIncidentRecord[]> {
  const scope = await getServerUserScope()
  const shouldScopeToMyData = !scope.isPrivileged || filters?.view_mode === 'my_data'

  const store = getIncStore()
  let list = [...store]

  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    try {
      const supabase = await createClient()
      let query = supabase.from('lab_incidents').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false })

      if (filters?.lab_id && filters.lab_id !== 'all') query = query.eq('lab_id', filters.lab_id)
      if (filters?.status && filters.status !== 'all') query = query.eq('status', filters.status as any)
      if (filters?.severity && filters.severity !== 'all') query = query.eq('severity', filters.severity as any)
      if (filters?.date) query = query.eq('date', filters.date)

      if (shouldScopeToMyData) {
        query = query.or(
          `reported_by_id.eq.${scope.userId},subject_teacher_name.eq.${scope.fullName},reported_by.eq.${scope.fullName}`
        )
      }

      const { data, error } = await query
      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        // Deduplicate before returning
        const seenIds = new Set<string>()
        const deduped: LabIncidentRecord[] = []
        for (const item of data) {
          if (item && item.id && !seenIds.has(item.id)) {
            seenIds.add(item.id)
            deduped.push(item as LabIncidentRecord)
          }
        }
        return deduped
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (filters?.lab_id && filters.lab_id !== 'all') {
    list = list.filter((i) => i.lab_id === filters.lab_id)
  }
  if (filters?.status && filters.status !== 'all') {
    list = list.filter((i) => i.status === filters.status)
  }
  if (filters?.severity && filters.severity !== 'all') {
    list = list.filter((i) => i.severity === filters.severity)
  }
  if (filters?.date) {
    list = list.filter((i) => i.date === filters.date)
  }

  if (shouldScopeToMyData) {
    const teacherNames = [scope.fullName, scope.teacherProfile?.name].filter(Boolean).map((n) => n!.toLowerCase())
    list = list.filter((i) => {
      if (scope.userId && i.reported_by_id === scope.userId) return true
      const subjTeacher = (i.subject_teacher_name || '').toLowerCase()
      const rep = (i.reported_by || '').toLowerCase()
      return teacherNames.some((tn) => subjTeacher.includes(tn) || rep.includes(tn))
    })
  }

  // Deduplicate in-memory list
  const seenIds = new Set<string>()
  const finalDeduped: LabIncidentRecord[] = []
  for (const item of list) {
    if (item && item.id && !seenIds.has(item.id)) {
      seenIds.add(item.id)
      finalDeduped.push(item)
    }
  }

  return finalDeduped
}

export async function getNotifications(role?: 'super_admin' | 'lab_incharge' | 'hod'): Promise<LabNotificationRecord[]> {
  const store = getNotifStore()
  let list = [...store]

  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    try {
      const supabase = await createClient()
      let query = supabase.from('lab_notifications').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      if (role) {
        query = query.or(`target_role.eq.${role},target_role.eq.super_admin`)
      }
      const { data, error } = await query
      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        // Deduplicate notifications by id
        const seen = new Set<string>()
        const deduped: LabNotificationRecord[] = []
        for (const notif of data) {
          if (notif && notif.id && !seen.has(notif.id)) {
            seen.add(notif.id)
            deduped.push(notif as LabNotificationRecord)
          }
        }
        return deduped
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (role) {
    list = list.filter((n) => n.target_role === role || n.target_role === 'super_admin')
  }

  const seen = new Set<string>()
  const finalDeduped: LabNotificationRecord[] = []
  for (const notif of list) {
    if (notif && notif.id && !seen.has(notif.id)) {
      seen.add(notif.id)
      finalDeduped.push(notif)
    }
  }

  return finalDeduped
}

export async function markNotificationRead(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean }> {
  const store = getNotifStore()
  const idx = store.findIndex((n) => n.id === id)
  if (idx !== -1) store[idx].is_read = true

  if (isSupabaseConfigured()) {
    try {
      const supabase = await createClient()
      await (supabase.from('lab_notifications') as any).update({ is_read: true }).eq('id', id)
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  return { success: true }
}

/**
 * 1. Student Practical Attendance & NEB Board Exam Compliance Report
 * Answers: Which students meet the mandatory 75% practical attendance threshold?
 */
export async function getStudentBoardComplianceReport(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
  classId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: StudentComplianceReport; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Resolve current academic year if not provided
    let yearId: string = params.academicYearId || ''
    let yearName = '2083 BS'
    if (!yearId) {
      const yrRes = await pool.query(
        `SELECT id, name FROM public.academic_years WHERE is_current = true LIMIT 1`
      )
      if (yrRes.rows.length > 0) {
        yearId = yrRes.rows[0].id
        yearName = yrRes.rows[0].name
      } else {
        yearId = '2083'
      }
    }

    // Resolve class if not provided
    const classId = params.classId || '12eng'
    const clsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, name FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1`,
      [classId]
    )
    const className = clsRes.rows[0]?.name || 'Class 12 Science'

    // 1. Fetch all active student enrollments for this class & year
    const enrollmentsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         se.id as enrollment_id,
         se.roll_number,
         s.id as student_id,
         s.full_name,
         s.registration_no
       FROM public.student_enrollments se
       JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
       WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 
         AND se.class_id = $2 
         AND se.status = 'active'
       ORDER BY se.roll_number ASC`,
      [yearId, classId]
    )

    // 2. Count total practical sessions conducted for this class cohort
    const sessionsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT COUNT(*)::int as total_held
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       LEFT JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = pl.class_subject_id
       WHERE (cs.class_id = $2 OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%')
         AND (pl.academic_year_id = $1 OR pl.academic_year_id IS NULL)
         AND pl.status = 'conducted'`,
      [yearId, classId, className]
    )
    const totalHeld = Math.max(1, sessionsRes.rows[0]?.total_held || 0)

    // 3. Count sessions attended by each enrollment in log_attendance
    const attendanceRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         la.enrollment_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN la.is_present = true THEN 1 END)::int as present_count
       FROM public.log_attendance la
       JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.id = la.log_id
       WHERE pl.status = 'conducted'
         AND (pl.academic_year_id = $1 OR pl.academic_year_id IS NULL)
       GROUP BY la.enrollment_id`,
      [yearId]
    )
    const attendanceMap = new Map<string, number>()
    attendanceRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      attendanceMap.set(r.enrollment_id, r.present_count)
    })

    let eligibleCount = 0
    let barredCount = 0
    let totalRateSum = 0

    const records: StudentComplianceRecord[] = enrollmentsRes.rows.map((row) => {
      const attended = attendanceMap.get(row.enrollment_id) ?? totalHeld // default full if no specific negative marks
      const clampedAttended = Math.min(totalHeld, attended)
      const absent = Math.max(0, totalHeld - clampedAttended)
      const rate = Math.round((clampedAttended / totalHeld) * 100)
      const isEligible = rate >= 75

      if (isEligible) eligibleCount++
      else barredCount++
      totalRateSum += rate

      return {
        student_id: row.student_id,
        enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id,
        roll_number: row.roll_number,
        full_name: row.full_name,
        registration_no: row.registration_no || null,
        sessions_held: totalHeld,
        sessions_attended: clampedAttended,
        absent_count: absent,
        attendance_rate_pct: rate,
        is_eligible: isEligible,
      }
    })

    const totalStudents = records.length
    const avgRate = totalStudents > 0 ? Math.round(totalRateSum / totalStudents) : 0

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        class_id: classId,
        class_name: className,
        academic_year_id: yearId,
        academic_year_name: yearName,
        total_students: totalStudents,
        eligible_students: eligibleCount,
        barred_students: barredCount,
        cohort_avg_rate_pct: avgRate,
        records,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching student board compliance report:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch compliance report.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 2. Syllabus & Subject Practical Completion Ledger
 * Answers: How many prescribed curriculum practicals have been completed vs quota?
 */
export async function getSyllabusProgressLedger(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
  classId?: string
  subjectId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: SyllabusProgressLedger; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const classId = params.classId || '12eng'
    const prescribedQuota = 20 // Standard NEB curriculum requirement

    // Query practical logs for this class/subject
    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         pl.id,
         pl.practical_title,
         pl.date,
         pl.period_label,
         pl.present_students,
         pl.total_students,
         pl.status,
         pl.skip_reason,
         COALESCE(pl.remarks ILIKE '%verified%', false) as incharge_verified,
         COALESCE(s.name, pl.subject_name) as subject_name,
         COALESCE(s.code, 'PRAC') as subject_code
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       LEFT JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = pl.class_subject_id
       LEFT JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id = cs.subject_id
       WHERE (cs.class_id = $1 OR pl.batch_group ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC, pl.created_at DESC`,
      [classId]
    )

    const practicals: SyllabusPracticalItem[] = []
    let completedCount = 0
    let skippedCount = 0
    let totalPresentSum = 0
    let totalRosterSum = 0
    const skippedTally: Record<string, number> = {}

    for (const row of res.rows) {
      const isConducted = row.status === 'conducted'
      if (isConducted) {
        completedCount++
        totalPresentSum += row.present_students || 0
        totalRosterSum += row.total_students || 0
      } else {
        skippedCount++
        const reason = row.skip_reason || 'Unspecified'
        skippedTally[reason] = (skippedTally[reason] || 0) + 1
      }

      const rate =
        row.total_students > 0
          ? Math.round(((row.present_students || 0) / row.total_students) * 100)
          : 0

      practicals.push({
        id: row.id,
        practical_title: row.practical_title,
        date: row.date,
        period_label: row.period_label || 'Period 3–4',
        present_students: row.present_students || 0,
        total_students: row.total_students || 0,
        attendance_rate_pct: rate,
        status: isConducted ? 'conducted' : 'skipped',
        skip_reason: row.skip_reason || null,
        incharge_verified: Boolean(row.incharge_verified),
      })
    }

    const avgAttendance =
      totalRosterSum > 0 ? Math.round((totalPresentSum / totalRosterSum) * 100) : 0
    const completionPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((completedCount / prescribedQuota) * 100))

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        class_id: classId,
        class_name: 'Class 12 Science',
        subject_id: params.subjectId || 'comp12',
        subject_name: 'Computer Science Practical',
        subject_code: 'COM-432',
        academic_year_id: params.academicYearId || '2083',
        prescribed_quota: prescribedQuota,
        completed_count: completedCount,
        skipped_count: skippedCount,
        completion_pct: completionPct,
        avg_attendance_pct: avgAttendance,
        practicals,
        skipped_reasons_tally: skippedTally,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching syllabus progress ledger:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch syllabus ledger.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 3. Faculty Practical Activity & Dual Sign-Off Audit Ledger
 * Answers: How many sessions has each faculty member conducted vs In-Charge audits?
 */
export async function getFacultyPracticalLedger(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: FacultyActivityRecord[]; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         p.id as teacher_id,
         p.full_name as teacher_name,
         p.email,
         COUNT(pl.id)::int as total_sessions,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.status = 'conducted' THEN 1 END)::int as conducted_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 END)::int as skipped_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(pl.present_students), 0)::int as total_students_taught,
         COALESCE(SUM(pl.total_students), 0)::int as total_students_enrolled,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN pl.remarks ILIKE '%verified%' THEN 1 END)::int as verified_count
       FROM public.profiles p
       LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON (pl.teacher_id = p.id OR pl.logged_by = p.id)
       WHERE p.role IN ('teacher', 'lab_incharge', 'hod')
       GROUP BY p.id, p.full_name, p.email
       ORDER BY conducted_count DESC, p.full_name ASC`
    )

    const records: FacultyActivityRecord[] = res.rows.map((r) => {
      const avgAtt =
        r.total_students_enrolled > 0
          ? Math.round((r.total_students_taught / r.total_students_enrolled) * 100)
          : 0
      const pendingVer = Math.max(0, r.conducted_count - r.verified_count)
      const verRate =
        r.conducted_count > 0 ? Math.round((r.verified_count / r.conducted_count) * 100) : 0

      return {
        teacher_id: r.teacher_id,
        teacher_name: r.teacher_name,
        email: r.email,
        total_sessions_logged: r.total_sessions,
        conducted_count: r.conducted_count,
        skipped_count: r.skipped_count,
        total_students_taught: r.total_students_taught,
        avg_attendance_pct: avgAtt,
        incharge_verified_count: r.verified_count,
        pending_verification_count: pendingVer,
        verification_rate_pct: verRate,
      }
    })

    return { success: true, data: records }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching faculty activity ledger:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch faculty ledger.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 4. Laboratory Room Occupancy & Capacity Utilization Index
 * Answers: Which labs are running at capacity, and what is our space utilization?
 */
export async function getLabOccupancyIndex(params: {
  academicYearId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: LabOccupancyRecord[]; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         l.id as lab_id,
         l.name as lab_name,
         l.capacity as lab_capacity,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::int as scheduled_slots_count,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id)::int as conducted_sessions_count,
         COALESCE(AVG(pl.present_students), 0)::float as avg_students
       FROM public.labs l
       LEFT JOIN public.schedules s ON s.lab_id = l.id AND s.status != 'cancelled'
       LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.lab_id = l.id AND pl.status = 'conducted'
       WHERE l.is_active = true
       GROUP BY l.id, l.name, l.capacity
       ORDER BY l.name ASC`
    )

    const records: LabOccupancyRecord[] = res.rows.map((r) => {
      // 36 operating hours/week (6 days * 6 hours, 10 AM - 4 PM)
      const maxWeeklyHours = 36
      const scheduledHours = r.scheduled_slots_count * 1.5 // 1.5 hr slots
      const actualHours = r.conducted_sessions_count * 1.5
      const occupancyRate = Math.min(100, Math.round((scheduledHours / maxWeeklyHours) * 100))

      const cap = r.lab_capacity || 34
      const avgStudents = Math.round(r.avg_students)
      const capUtil = cap > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((avgStudents / cap) * 100)) : 0

      return {
        lab_id: r.lab_id,
        lab_name: r.lab_name,
        lab_capacity: cap,
        scheduled_weekly_hours: Math.round(scheduledHours * 10) / 10,
        actual_conducted_hours: Math.round(actualHours * 10) / 10,
        occupancy_rate_pct: occupancyRate,
        avg_students_per_session: avgStudents,
        capacity_utilization_pct: capUtil,
        busiest_day: 'Tuesday',
        busiest_slot: 'Period 3–4 (11:45 AM)',
      }
    })

    return { success: true, data: records }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching lab occupancy index:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch occupancy index.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 5. Advanced Workstation Operational Analytics & MTTR Hotspots
 * Answers: Which PCs are failing repeatedly, what is our uptime, and MTTR?
 */
export async function getWorkstationReliabilityAnalytics(params: {
  labId?: string
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: WorkstationReliabilityReport; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const targetLab = params.labId || 'comp'

    // 1. Fetch workstations with issue metrics
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         w.id,
         w.label,
         w.row_label,
         w.device_type,
         w.is_active,
         COUNT(wi.id)::int as total_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status != 'resolved' THEN 1 END)::int as open_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status = 'resolved' THEN 1 END)::int as resolved_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END)::int as critical_issues,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 END)::int as in_progress_issues,
         COALESCE(
           SUM(
             CASE 
               WHEN wi.resolved_at IS NOT NULL 
               THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wi.resolved_at - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0
               WHEN wi.status != 'resolved' 
               THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0
               ELSE 0 
             END
           ), 0
         )::float as downtime_hours
       FROM public.workstations w
       LEFT JOIN public.workstation_issues wi ON wi.workstation_id = w.id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1 AND w.is_active = true
       GROUP BY w.id, w.label, w.row_label, w.device_type, w.is_active
       ORDER BY total_issues DESC, w.label ASC`,
      [targetLab]
    )

    // 2. Fault categories breakdown
    const catRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         COALESCE(c.type, 'hardware') as category_type,
         COUNT(wi.id)::int as issue_count
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       LEFT JOIN public.issue_categories c ON c.id = wi.category_id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1
       GROUP BY category_type`,
      [targetLab]
    )
    const categoryTally: Record<string, number> = {}
    catRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      categoryTally[r.category_type] = r.issue_count
    })

    // 3. Compute MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) across all resolved issues in lab
    const mttrRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (wi.resolved_at - wi.created_at)) / 3600.0)::float as avg_resolution_hours
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       WHERE w.lab_id = $1 AND wi.status = 'resolved' AND wi.resolved_at IS NOT NULL`,
      [targetLab]
    )
    const overallMttr = Math.round((mttrRes.rows[0]?.avg_resolution_hours || 4.2) * 10) / 10

    let operationalCount = 0
    let faultyCount = 0
    let underRepairCount = 0
    let totalDowntimeHours = 0

    const workstationRecords: WorkstationReliabilityRecord[] = wsRes.rows.map((row) => {
      let status = 'operational'
      if (row.open_issues > 0) {
        status = row.in_progress_issues > 0 ? 'under_repair' : 'flagged'
      }

      if (status === 'operational') operationalCount++
      else if (status === 'under_repair') underRepairCount++
      else faultyCount++

      const dtHours = Math.round(row.downtime_hours * 10) / 10
      totalDowntimeHours += dtHours

      // Assume 180 academic lab hours/month (30 days * 6 hours)
      const uptime = Math.max(70, Math.min(100, Math.round((1 - dtHours / 180) * 100)))

      return {
        workstation_id: row.id,
        workstation_label: row.label,
        row_label: row.row_label,
        device_type: row.device_type,
        status,
        total_issues_count: row.total_issues,
        open_issues_count: row.open_issues,
        resolved_issues_count: row.resolved_issues,
        critical_issues_count: row.critical_issues,
        downtime_hours: dtHours,
        uptime_pct: uptime,
        last_serviced_at: null,
      }
    })

    const totalWs = workstationRecords.length
    const overallUptime =
      totalWs > 0
        ? Math.round(
            workstationRecords.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.uptime_pct, 0) / totalWs
          )
        : 98

    // Hotspots: PCs with >= 1 reported issue sorted descending
    const hotspots = workstationRecords.filter((w) => w.total_issues_count > 0).slice(0, 8)

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        lab_id: targetLab,
        lab_name: 'Computer Engineering Lab 01',
        total_workstations: totalWs,
        operational_count: operationalCount,
        faulty_count: faultyCount,
        under_repair_count: underRepairCount,
        overall_uptime_pct: overallUptime,
        overall_mttr_hours: overallMttr,
        fault_categories_breakdown: categoryTally,
        hotspot_workstations: hotspots,
        workstations: workstationRecords,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching workstation reliability analytics:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch workstation analytics.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 6. Workstation Technical Lifecycle Biography
 * Answers: What is the full historical service and seating record for this specific PC?
 */
export async function getWorkstationTechnicalBiography(
  workstationId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: WorkstationBiography; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()

    // 1. Workstation Core
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, label, row_label, device_type, is_active, created_at 
       FROM public.workstations WHERE id = $1`,
      [workstationId]
    )
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Workstation not found.' }
    }
    const ws = wsRes.rows[0]

    // 2. Issues Timeline
    const issuesRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         id, title, severity, status, reported_by_name, created_at, resolved_at, resolution_notes,
         CASE 
           WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL 
           THEN ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1)::float
           ELSE NULL 
         END as duration_hours
       FROM public.workstation_issues
       WHERE workstation_id = $1
       ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
      [workstationId]
    )

    // Derive status
    const hasOpen = issuesRes.rows.some((i) => i.status !== 'resolved')
    const hasInProgress = issuesRes.rows.some((i) => i.status === 'in_progress')
    const derivedStatus = hasOpen ? (hasInProgress ? 'under_repair' : 'flagged') : 'operational'

    // 3. Maintenance Servicing History
    const maintRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         ml.id as log_id,
         mp.title as plan_title,
         COALESCE(p.full_name, ml.performed_by_id::text) as performed_by,
         ml.service_date as performed_at,
         COALESCE(ml.work_performed, ml.remarks) as observations
       FROM public.maintenance_logs ml
       LEFT JOIN public.maintenance_plans mp ON mp.id = ml.plan_id
       LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ml.performed_by_id
       WHERE ml.asset_identifier = $1 
          OR ml.remarks ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
       ORDER BY ml.service_date DESC`,
      [ws.label]
    )

    // 4. Student Seating History
    const seatingRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         ay.name as academic_year,
         c.name as class_name,
         s.full_name as student_name,
         se.roll_number
       FROM public.workstation_seat_plans wsp
       JOIN public.student_enrollments se ON se.id = wsp.enrollment_id
       JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
       JOIN public.classes c ON c.id = wsp.class_id
       JOIN public.academic_years ay ON ay.id = wsp.academic_year_id
       WHERE wsp.workstation_id = $1
       ORDER BY wsp.created_at DESC`,
      [workstationId]
    )

    // 5. Practical Session Forensic Usage Timeline
    const forensicRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT 
         pl.id as log_id,
         pl.date,
         pl.period_label,
         pl.subject_name,
         pl.batch_group,
         pl.practical_title,
         pl.topic_learned,
         pl.seating_snapshot
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       WHERE pl.seating_snapshot IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC, pl.created_at DESC
       LIMIT 100`
    )

    const practicalUsageTimeline: NonNullable<WorkstationBiography['practical_usage_timeline']> = []

    for (const row of forensicRes.rows) {
      if (!Array.isArray(row.seating_snapshot)) continue
      const stationEntry = row.seating_snapshot.find(
        (entry: any) =>
          entry.workstation_id === workstationId ||
          (entry.workstation_label && entry.workstation_label.toLowerCase() === (ws.label || '').toLowerCase())
      )

      if (stationEntry && stationEntry.student_name) {
        practicalUsageTimeline.push({
          log_id: row.log_id,
          date: row.date,
          period_label: row.period_label || '',
          subject_name: row.subject_name || '',
          batch_group: row.batch_group || '',
          practical_title: row.practical_title || '',
          topic_learned: row.topic_learned || null,
          student_name: stationEntry.student_name,
          roll_number: stationEntry.roll_number != null ? Number(stationEntry.roll_number) : null,
          is_present: !!stationEntry.is_present,
          is_override: !!stationEntry.is_override,
          original_workstation_label: stationEntry.original_workstation_label || null,
        })
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        workstation_id: ws.id,
        label: ws.label,
        row_label: ws.row_label,
        device_type: ws.device_type,
        status: derivedStatus,
        created_at: ws.created_at,
        issues: issuesRes.rows,
        maintenance_history: maintRes.rows,
        student_seating_history: seatingRes.rows,
        practical_usage_timeline: practicalUsageTimeline,
      },
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching workstation biography:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch workstation biography.' }
  }
}

/**
 * 7. Real-time Derived Institutional Reminders & Operational Queue
 * Synthesizes alerts from canonical database relations:
 * - Critical workstation issues (> 48h or critical severity)
 * - Overdue preventive maintenance tasks
 * - Conducted practical logs pending Lab In-Charge dual sign-off
 * - Cohorts at risk of failing the NEB 75% attendance threshold
 */
export async function getInstitutionalReminders(): Promise<{
  success: boolean
  data?: InstitutionalReminderItem[]
  error?: string
}> {
  try {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const reminders: InstitutionalReminderItem[] = []

    // 1. Critical open workstation issues
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT wi.id, wi.title, wi.severity, wi.created_at, w.label as ws_label, l.name as lab_name
       FROM public.workstation_issues wi
       JOIN public.workstations w ON w.id = wi.workstation_id
       LEFT JOIN public.labs l ON l.id = w.lab_id
       WHERE wi.status != 'resolved' AND wi.severity IN ('critical', 'high')
       ORDER BY wi.created_at DESC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    wsRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `ws-issue-${r.id}`,
        type: 'critical_workstation',
        severity: r.severity === 'critical' ? 'critical' : 'high',
        title: `Workstation Fault: ${r.ws_label}`,
        message: `${r.title} in ${r.lab_name || 'Laboratory'}. Immediate technician triage required.`,
        linkUrl: '/maintenance',
        timestamp: new Date(r.created_at).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 2. Overdue preventive maintenance tasks
    const mrRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT mr.id, mr.due_date, mp.title, l.name as lab_name
       FROM public.maintenance_reminders mr
       JOIN public.maintenance_plans mp ON mp.id = mr.plan_id
       LEFT JOIN public.labs l ON l.id = mp.lab_id
       WHERE mr.status IN ('pending', 'overdue') AND mr.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
       ORDER BY mr.due_date ASC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    mrRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `mr-overdue-${r.id}`,
        type: 'overdue_maintenance',
        severity: 'high',
        title: `Overdue Routine: ${r.title}`,
        message: `Maintenance for ${r.lab_name || 'Lab'} was due on ${r.due_date}.`,
        linkUrl: '/maintenance',
        timestamp: new Date(r.due_date).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 3. Conducted sessions pending verification audit (last 14 days)
    const verRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT pl.id, pl.practical_title, pl.date, pl.batch_group, pl.subject_name
       FROM public.practical_logs pl
       WHERE pl.status = 'conducted'
         AND (pl.remarks IS NULL OR pl.remarks NOT ILIKE '%verified%')
         AND pl.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days'
       ORDER BY pl.date DESC
       LIMIT 5`
    )
    verRes.rows.forEach((r) => {
      reminders.push({
        id: `pl-pending-${r.id}`,
        type: 'pending_verification',
        severity: 'medium',
        title: `Pending In-Charge Audit: ${r.batch_group}`,
        message: `"${r.practical_title}" conducted on ${r.date} requires digital dual sign-off.`,
        linkUrl: '/records',
        timestamp: new Date(r.date).toISOString(),
      })
    })

    // 4. Low attendance cohorts
    const compRes = await getStudentBoardComplianceReport({ classId: '12eng' })
    if (compRes.success && compRes.data && compRes.data.barred_students > 0) {
      reminders.push({
        id: `cohort-low-${compRes.data.class_id}`,
        type: 'low_attendance_cohort',
        severity: 'high',
        title: `Board Exam Alert: ${compRes.data.class_name}`,
        message: `${compRes.data.barred_students} student(s) currently below the 75% practical attendance threshold.`,
        linkUrl: '/analytics',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
    }

    return { success: true, data: reminders }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error fetching institutional reminders:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch reminders.' }
  }
}

      filename,
      contentType: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
    }

    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Failed to export compliance register.' }
  }
}

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { getPgPool } from '@/lib/db'
import { getServerUserScope } from '@/lib/context/server-user-scope'
import { recordAuditEvent } from '@/lib/audit'

import {
  type LabFacilityStatus,
  type LabFacilityPayload,
  validateLabStatus,
  deriveLabIsActive,
} from '@/lib/lab-status'

export type { LabFacilityPayload, LabFacilityStatus }

/**
 * Update an existing laboratory facility record in PostgreSQL.
 * Persists capacity, room code, status, and classification.
 */
export async function updateLabFacility(
  id: string,
  updates: Partial<LabFacilityPayload>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; data?: any; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged || !['super_admin', 'lab_incharge'].includes(scope.role)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admin and Lab In-Charge can modify laboratory facilities.',
      }
    }

    let validatedStatus: LabFacilityStatus | null = null
    let isActive: boolean | null = null

    if (updates.status !== undefined) {
      validatedStatus = validateLabStatus(updates.status)
      isActive = deriveLabIsActive(validatedStatus)
    }

    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Fetch existing state for tamper-evident structured diff (match on id, code, or name)
    const prevRes = await pool.query(
      'SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1 OR (code IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(code) = UPPER($1)) OR (name IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(name) = UPPER($1))',
      [id]
    )
    const beforeState = prevRes.rows[0] || null
    const targetLabId = beforeState?.id || id

    const res = await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.labs
      SET
        name = COALESCE($1, name),
        code = COALESCE($2, code),
        capacity = COALESCE($3, capacity),
        type = COALESCE($4, type),
        status = COALESCE($5, status),
        is_active = COALESCE($6, is_active)
      WHERE id = $7
      RETURNING *;
      `,
      [
        updates.name || null,
        updates.code ? updates.code.toUpperCase() : null,
        updates.capacity !== undefined ? Number(updates.capacity) : null,
        updates.type || null,
        validatedStatus,
        isActive,
        targetLabId,
      ]
    )

    if (res.rowCount === 0) {
      // If row does not exist, insert it
      const insertStatus = validatedStatus || 'Operational'
      const insertIsActive = isActive !== null ? isActive : true

      const insertRes = await pool.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO public.labs (id, name, code, capacity, type, status, is_active)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
          name = EXCLUDED.name,
          code = EXCLUDED.code,
          capacity = EXCLUDED.capacity,
          type = EXCLUDED.type,
          status = EXCLUDED.status,
          is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active
        RETURNING *;
        `,
        [
          targetLabId,
          updates.name || 'Laboratory Facility',
          updates.code ? updates.code.toUpperCase() : targetLabId.toUpperCase(),
          updates.capacity !== undefined ? Number(updates.capacity) : 40,
          updates.type || 'computer_lab',
          insertStatus,
          insertIsActive,
        ]
      )

      await recordAuditEvent({
        action: 'CREATE',
        entityType: 'lab',
        entityId: targetLabId,
        entityLabel: insertRes.rows[0]?.name || targetLabId,
        after: insertRes.rows[0],
        metadata: { operation: 'upsert_lab_facility' },
      })

      revalidatePath('/admin')
      revalidatePath('/maintenance')
      revalidatePath('/schedules')
      revalidatePath('/')
      return { success: true, data: insertRes.rows[0] }
    }

    // Record UPDATE audit event with structured diff
    await recordAuditEvent({
      action: 'UPDATE',
      entityType: 'lab',
      entityId: targetLabId,
      entityLabel: res.rows[0]?.name || beforeState?.name || updates.name || targetLabId,
      before: beforeState || { id: targetLabId },
      after: res.rows[0],
      metadata: { operation: 'update_lab_facility' },
    })

    // Revalidate affected cache paths
    revalidatePath('/admin')
    revalidatePath('/maintenance')
    revalidatePath('/schedules')
    revalidatePath('/')

    return { success: true, data: res.rows[0] }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`[LMR] Failed to update lab "${id}":`, err)
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Database update failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * Delete or deactivate a laboratory facility.
 */
export async function deleteLabFacility(
  id: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const scope = await getServerUserScope()
    if (!scope.isPrivileged || !['super_admin', 'lab_incharge'].includes(scope.role)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admin and Lab In-Charge can delete laboratory facilities.',
      }
    }

    const pool = getPgPool()

    // Query before-state for audit record
    const prevRes = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1', [id])
    const beforeState = prevRes.rows[0] || null

    // Attempt permanent deletion from PostgreSQL
    try {
      const delRes = await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;`, [id])
      if (delRes.rowCount && delRes.rowCount > 0) {
        await recordAuditEvent({
          action: 'DELETE',
          entityType: 'lab',
          entityId: id,
          entityLabel: beforeState?.name || id,
          before: beforeState,
          metadata: { operation: 'permanent_delete_lab' },
        })

        revalidatePath('/admin')
        revalidatePath('/maintenance')
        revalidatePath('/schedules')
        revalidatePath('/')
        return { success: true }
      }
    } catch (fkErr: any) {
      // Foreign key violation (PostgreSQL 23503) means active/historical records link to this room
      if (fkErr.code === '23503') {
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE public.labs SET is_active = false, status = 'Inactive' WHERE id = $1;`,
          [id]
        )

        await recordAuditEvent({
          action: 'UPDATE',
          entityType: 'lab',
          entityId: id,
          entityLabel: beforeState?.name || id,
          before: beforeState,
          after: { ...beforeState, is_active: false, status: 'Inactive' },
          metadata: {
            operation: 'soft_deactivate_lab',
            reason: 'linked_historical_records_fk_23503',
          },
        })

        revalidatePath('/admin')
        revalidatePath('/maintenance')
        revalidatePath('/schedules')
        revalidatePath('/')
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'This laboratory has linked historical records (practical logs, timetables, or maintenance) and cannot be permanently purged. It has been deactivated instead.',
        }
      }
      throw fkErr
    }

    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`[LMR] Failed to delete lab "${id}":`, err)
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to delete laboratory' }
  }
}
