            labId,
            subjectName,
            batchName,
            startTime,
            endTime,
            item.slotId || 't2',
            item.dayKey || 'sun',
            span,
            isMerged,
            status,
            JSON.stringify(metadata),
          ]
        )
        insertedCount++
      }
      console.log(`✓ Seeded ${insertedCount} timetable sessions into public.schedules.`)
    }

    // Extract DEFAULT_CLASSES & DEFAULT_SUBJECTS
    const classesStart = masterDataContent.indexOf('export const DEFAULT_CLASSES: ClassCohort[] = [')
    const subjectsStart = masterDataContent.indexOf('export const DEFAULT_SUBJECTS: SubjectItem[] = [')
    if (classesStart !== -1 && subjectsStart !== -1) {
      const classesCode = masterDataContent.substring(
        classesStart + 'export const DEFAULT_CLASSES: ClassCohort[] = ['.length - 1,
        subjectsStart
      ).trim().replace(/;$/, '')
      const subjectsCode = masterDataContent.substring(
        subjectsStart + 'export const DEFAULT_SUBJECTS: SubjectItem[] = ['.length - 1
      ).trim().replace(/;$/, '')

      const evalClasses = new Function(`return ${classesCode};`)
      const evalSubjects = new Function(`return ${subjectsCode};`)
      const classesData = evalClasses()
      const subjectsData = evalSubjects()

      await client.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO public.institution_settings (key, value)
        VALUES 
          ('infrastructure_classes', $1::jsonb),
          ('infrastructure_subjects', $2::jsonb)
        ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value;
        `,
        [JSON.stringify(classesData), JSON.stringify(subjectsData)]
      )
      console.log(`✓ Seeded ${classesData.length} classes and ${subjectsData.length} curriculum subjects into institution_settings.`)
    }

#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * 🚀 LabSync LIMS - 50-Workstation Laboratory Swarm & Stress Simulator
 *
 * Use this script to test realistic high-concurrency lab scenarios:
 * 1. Morning Lab Power-On: 50 PCs boot simultaneously and send hardware handshakes.
 * 2. Simultaneous Student Distress: Multiple students report hardware/software faults at the same time.
 * 3. Telemetry & Latency Benchmark: Demonstrates PostgreSQL connection pooling throughput.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --boot-all
 *   node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --distress 10
 *   node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --clean
 *   node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --status
 */

import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import pg from 'pg'

// 1. Load local environment configuration (.env.local)
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

function resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) return rawUrl
  if (rawUrl.includes('db.') && rawUrl.includes('.supabase.co')) {
    const match = rawUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
    if (match) {
      const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
      const decodedPass = decodeURIComponent(pass)
      return `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(decodedPass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
    }
  }
  return rawUrl
}

const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(process.env.DATABASE_URL)
if (!connectionString) {
  console.error('❌ Error: DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
  max: 20, // Connection pool
  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
})

const args = process.argv.slice(2)
const isBootAll = args.includes('--boot-all')
const isDistress = args.includes('--distress')
const isClean = args.includes('--clean')
const isStatus = args.includes('--status')
const distressCount = parseInt(args[args.indexOf('--distress') + 1], 10) || 8

async function main() {
  console.log('\n=================================================================')
  console.log('  🖥️  LABSYNC LIMS — 50-WORKSTATION REAL-TIME SIMULATOR')

  try {

      await showLabStatus()
      if (!isStatus) {

        console.log('  node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --boot-all     (Simulate all 50 PCs booting at once)')
        console.log('  node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --distress 10  (Simulate 10 students filing issues simultaneously)')
        console.log('  node scripts/simulate-lab-stress.mjs --clean        (Resolve/clear all simulated distress tickets)')

async function showLabStatus() {
  const wsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT 
      w.label,
      w.machine_guid,
      w.lan_ip,
      w.last_seen_at,
      COUNT(wi.id) as open_issues
    FROM public.workstations w
    LEFT JOIN public.workstation_issues wi ON wi.workstation_id = w.id AND wi.status != 'resolved'
    WHERE w.lab_id = 'comp'
    GROUP BY w.id, w.label, w.machine_guid, w.lan_ip, w.last_seen_at
    ORDER BY 
      substring(w.label from '^[A-Za-z]+')::text,
      COALESCE(substring(w.label from '[0-9]+')::int, 0),
      w.label
  `)

  const total = wsRes.rows.length
  const bound = wsRes.rows.filter((r) => r.machine_guid).length
  const activeRecent = wsRes.rows.filter(
    (r) => r.last_seen_at && Date.now() - new Date(r.last_seen_at).getTime() < 3600000 * 24
  ).length
  const withIssues = wsRes.rows.filter((r) => parseInt(r.open_issues, 10) > 0).length

  console.log(`📊 Current Computer Lab Telemetry:`)
  console.log(`   • Total Workstations: ${total}`)
  console.log(`   • Bound / Active Machines: ${bound} / ${total}`)
  console.log(`   • Online / Heartbeat in 24h: ${activeRecent} / ${total}`)
  console.log(`   • Workstations with Active Issues: ${withIssues}`)
}

async function simulate50PcBoot() {
  console.log('⚡ SIMULATING 50 WORKSTATIONS BOOTING UP CONCURRENTLY...')
  const start = Date.now()

  const wsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT id, label FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' ORDER BY label ASC
  `)
  const stations = wsRes.rows
  console.log(`   Found ${stations.length} workstations to boot.`)

  const cpus = [
    'AMD Ryzen 5 3500U with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (4C/8T)',
    'Intel Core i5-10400 CPU @ 2.90GHz (6C/12T)',
    'Intel Core i5-11400 CPU @ 2.60GHz (6C/12T)',
    'AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics (6C/12T)',
  ]

  // Fire updates concurrently in batches of 10 to demonstrate pooling
  const updatePromises = stations.map((ws, i) => {
    const clean = ws.label.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '').toUpperCase()
    const guid = `SWARM-${clean}-${(1000 + i).toString()}`
    const ip = `192.168.1.${10 + i}`
    const cpu = cpus[i % cpus.length]
    const ram = i % 3 === 0 ? 16 : 8
    const disk = 120 + (i * 7) % 150

    const specs = {
      cpu,
      ram_gb: ram,
      drive_c_free_gb: disk,
      drive_c_total_gb: 256,
      os: 'Windows 11 Pro 64-bit',
      ip,
      booted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }

    return pool.query(
      `UPDATE public.workstations 
       SET machine_guid = COALESCE(machine_guid, $1),
           lan_ip = $2,
           hardware_specs = $3::jsonb,
           last_seen_at = NOW(),
           updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $4`,
      [guid, ip, JSON.stringify(specs), ws.id]
    )
  })

  await Promise.all(updatePromises)
  const elapsed = Date.now() - start

  console.log(`\n✅ SUCCESS! All ${stations.length} workstations booted and synchronized.`)
  console.log(`   ⏱️  Total Duration: ${elapsed} ms (avg ${(elapsed / stations.length).toFixed(1)} ms per machine)`)
  console.log(`   🌐 Every station now has verified hardware specs, IP, and live heartbeat.`)
  console.log(`   💡 Check the CAD floor at http://localhost:3000/computer-lab to see all green nodes!\n`)
}

import pg from 'pg';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

function loadEnv(file) {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return;
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
  for (let line of lines) {
    let trimmed = line.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
    if (eqIdx === -1) continue;
    const k = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
    let v = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim();
    if ((v.startsWith('"') && v.endsWith('"')) || (v.startsWith("'") && v.endsWith("'"))) {
      v = v.slice(1, -1);
    }
    process.env[k] = v;
  }
}
loadEnv('.env.local');

  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
});

    { email: 'a.karki@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Teacher@12345' },
    { email: 'teacher@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Teacher@12345' },
    { email: 'n.poudel@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Teacher@12345' },
    { email: 'admin@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Admin@12345' },
    { email: 'incharge@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Incharge@12345' },
    { email: 'hod@rrl.edu.np', pass: 'Hod@12345' },
  ];

  for (const acc of accounts) {
    await client.query(`
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET encrypted_password = crypt($1, gen_salt('bf', 10)),
          email_confirmed_at = COALESCE(email_confirmed_at, now())
      WHERE email = $2
    `, [acc.pass, acc.email]);

    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET approval_status = 'approved',
          is_active = true
      WHERE email = $1
    `, [acc.email]);

    console.log(`✓ Synchronized password and approval for: ${acc.email} -> ${acc.pass}`);
  }

  await client.end();
  console.log('Done.');
}

async function main() {
  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    const users = (await client.query('SELECT id, email, full_name, role FROM public.profiles')).rows;
    for (const u of users) {
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        const d1 = await client.query('DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1', [u.id]);
        const d2 = await client.query('DELETE FROM auth.identities WHERE user_id = $1', [u.id]);
        const d3 = await client.query('DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1', [u.id]);
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        console.log(`✓ Can delete user: ${u.email} (${u.full_name}) - rows affected: profiles=${d1.rowCount}, identities=${d2.rowCount}, users=${d3.rowCount}`);
      } catch (err) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        console.error(`✗ CANNOT delete user: ${u.email} (${u.full_name}) - REASON:`, err.message);
      }
    }
  } finally {
    client.release();
    await pool.end();
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },

async function main() {
  console.log('=== MILESTONE 1 END-TO-END VERIFICATION SCRIPT ===\n');

  try {
    // 1. Check CHECK constraint on public.labs
    console.log('[Test 1] Testing PostgreSQL CHECK constraint on public.labs...');
    let threwCheckError = false;
    try {
      await pool.query(`UPDATE public.labs SET status = 'InvalidStatus' WHERE id = 'comp';`);
    } catch (e) {
      threwCheckError = true;
      console.log('  ✓ PostgreSQL CHECK constraint successfully blocked invalid status:', e.message);
    }
    if (!threwCheckError) {
      throw new Error('PostgreSQL CHECK constraint failed to block invalid status!');
    }

    // 2. Test switching status to 'Under Maintenance' in PostgreSQL
    console.log('\n[Test 2] Updating Computer Engineering Lab 01 to "Under Maintenance"...');
    const updateMaintRes = await pool.query(`
      UPDATE public.labs SET status = 'Under Maintenance' WHERE id = 'comp' RETURNING *;
    `);
    console.log('  ✓ Updated lab row:', updateMaintRes.rows[0]);

    // 3. Test booking guard logic against database status
    console.log('\n[Test 3] Testing server-side booking guard with "Under Maintenance" lab...');
    const compLabRow = (await pool.query(`SELECT id, name, status, is_active FROM public.labs WHERE id = 'comp';`)).rows[0];
    
    function validateBooking(lab) {
      if (lab.status === 'Under Maintenance') {
        return { error: `Booking Rejected: "${lab.name}" is currently Under Maintenance and cannot be booked.` };
      }
      if (!lab.is_active || lab.status === 'Inactive') {
        return { error: `Booking Rejected: "${lab.name}" is currently Inactive.` };
      }
      return { success: true };
    }

    const bookingAttempt1 = validateBooking(compLabRow);
    console.log('  Booking attempt while Under Maintenance result:', bookingAttempt1);
    if (!bookingAttempt1.error) {
      throw new Error('Booking guard failed to reject Under Maintenance lab!');
    }
    console.log('  ✓ Server-side booking guard successfully rejected slot booking.');

    // 4. Test practical log guard logic against database status
    console.log('\n[Test 4] Testing server-side practical log guard with "Under Maintenance" lab...');
    function validatePracticalLog(lab) {
      if (lab.status === 'Under Maintenance') {
        return { success: false, error: `Practical log rejected: "${lab.name}" is currently Under Maintenance.` };
      }
      if (!lab.is_active || lab.status === 'Inactive') {
        return { success: false, error: `Practical log rejected: "${lab.name}" is Inactive.` };
      }
      return { success: true };
    }

    const logAttempt1 = validatePracticalLog(compLabRow);
    console.log('  Log attempt while Under Maintenance result:', logAttempt1);
    if (logAttempt1.success) {
      throw new Error('Practical log guard failed to reject Under Maintenance lab!');
    }
    console.log('  ✓ Server-side practical log guard successfully blocked session logging.');

    // 5. Restore Computer Lab to 'Operational'
    console.log('\n[Test 5] Restoring Computer Engineering Lab 01 to "Operational"...');
    const updateOpRes = await pool.query(`
      UPDATE public.labs SET status = 'Operational' WHERE id = 'comp' RETURNING *;
    `);
    console.log('  ✓ Restored lab row:', updateOpRes.rows[0]);

    const bookingAttempt2 = validateBooking(updateOpRes.rows[0]);
    console.log('  Booking attempt after restoration to Operational result:', bookingAttempt2);
    if (!bookingAttempt2.success) {
      throw new Error('Booking guard incorrectly blocked Operational lab!');
    }
    console.log('  ✓ Booking and logging permitted when status is Operational.');

    console.log('\n=== ALL MILESTONE 1 VERIFICATION TESTS PASSED (5/5) ===');

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Test execution failed:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

const user = process.env.GMAIL_USER?.trim();
const pass = process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD?.trim().replace(/\s+/g, '');

console.log('Testing Gmail SMTP Connection with user:', user);

if (!user || !pass) {
  console.error('❌ Missing GMAIL_USER or GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD');
  process.exit(1);
}

const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
  service: 'gmail',
  auth: {
    user,
    pass,
  },
});

transporter.verify((error, success) => {
  if (error) {
    console.error('❌ Gmail SMTP Verification Failed:', error.message);
    process.exit(1);
  } else {
    console.log('✅ Gmail SMTP Server is ready to deliver real institutional OTP emails!');
    process.exit(0);
  }
});

  });
  if (error) {
    console.error('Supabase login failed:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const session = data.session;
  const cookieVal = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({
    access_token: session.access_token,
    refresh_token: session.refresh_token,
    expires_at: session.expires_at,
    expires_in: session.expires_in,
    token_type: session.token_type,
    user: session.user,
  }));
  const cookieName = 'sb-' + projectRef + '-auth-token';
  const cookieHeader = cookieName + '=' + cookieVal;

  const routes = [
    { name: 'records', path: '/print/records' },
    { name: 'incidents', path: '/print/incidents' },
    { name: 'maintenance', path: '/maintenance' } // note: print view is on /maintenance print action or /print/maintenance
  ];

  for (const route of routes) {

    const res = await fetch(`http://localhost:3001${route.path}`, {
      headers: { 'Cookie': cookieHeader },
      redirect: 'manual'
    });
    console.log(`Status: ${res.status}`);
    const html = await res.text();
    
    // Check whether the HTML contains @page or style tags
    const hasPageRule = html.includes('@page');
    console.log(`Contains '@page' in raw HTML: ${hasPageRule}`);

    const pdfFile = `D:\\Projects\\LMR\\scratch\\live_${route.name}.pdf`;
    
    // In order for headless chrome to load external assets, inject <base href="http://localhost:3001/">
    const htmlWithBase = html.replace('<head>', '<head><base href="http://localhost:3001/">');
    fs.writeFileSync(htmlFile, htmlWithBase);

    try {
      execFileSync(chrome, ['--headless', '--disable-gpu', `--print-to-pdf=${pdfFile}`, htmlFile]);
      const pdf = fs.readFileSync(pdfFile, 'utf8');
      const mediaBoxes = [...pdf.matchAll(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/g)];
      console.log(`Total Pages: ${mediaBoxes.length}`);
      mediaBoxes.forEach((m, idx) => {
        const w = parseFloat(m[3]) - parseFloat(m[1]);
        const h = parseFloat(m[4]) - parseFloat(m[2]);
        const isLandscape = w > h;
        console.log(`  Page ${idx + 1}: w=${w.toFixed(1)}pt (${(w * 25.4 / 72).toFixed(1)}mm), h=${h.toFixed(1)}pt (${(h * 25.4 / 72).toFixed(1)}mm) -> ${isLandscape ? 'LANDSCAPE' : 'PORTRAIT'}`);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`Chrome print failed for ${route.name}:`, err.message);
    }
  }

    RETURNING id;

      approval_status = 'pending',
      is_active = FALSE;
  `, [userId, testEmail]);

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

import http from 'http';

async function testHttpEndpoint(path) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    http.get(`http://localhost:3000${path}`, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', (chunk) => (data += chunk));
      res.on('end', () => {
        resolve({
          path,
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
          hasContent: data.length > 500,
          length: data.length,
        });
      });
    }).on('error', (err) => {
      resolve({ path, error: err.message });
    });
  });
}

async function run() {
  console.log('🧪 Starting Practical Records & Incident Register End-to-End Test...\n');

  const routes = [
    '/records',
    '/records/incidents',
    '/print/records',
    '/print/incidents',
    '/print/daily-log',
  ];

  console.log('🌐 Testing HTTP Responses from Next.js Dev Server:');
  for (const route of routes) {
    const result = await testHttpEndpoint(route);
    if (result.error) {
      console.error(`  ❌ ${route}: Error - ${result.error}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`  ✅ ${route}: HTTP ${result.statusCode} (Bytes: ${result.length})`);
    }
  }

  console.log('\n🎉 HTTP Endpoint Verification Complete!');
}

function resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) return rawUrl
  if (rawUrl.includes('db.') && rawUrl.includes('.supabase.co')) {
    const match = rawUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
    if (match) {
      const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
      const decodedPass = decodeURIComponent(pass)
      return `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(decodedPass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
    }
  }
  return rawUrl
}

function logHeader(title) {
  console.log('\n\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m')
  console.log(`\x1b[1m\x1b[37m  ${title}\x1b[0m`)
  console.log('\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m')
}

function recordResult(scenario, passed, durationMs, details) {
  results.push({ scenario, passed, durationMs, details })
  const icon = passed ? '\x1b[32m[PASS]\x1b[0m' : '\x1b[31m[FAIL]\x1b[0m'
  const time = `\x1b[90m(${durationMs}ms)\x1b[0m`
  console.log(`  ${icon} ${scenario} ${time}`)
  if (details) {
    console.log(`         \x1b[90m${details}\x1b[0m`)
  }
}

  console.log(`  Production Reliability    : \x1b[32m${((passCount / (results.length || 1)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%\x1b[0m`)
  console.log('\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m\n')

  if (failCount > 0) {
    process.exit(1)
  }
  process.exit(0)

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },

// Replicate computeStructuredDiff
const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS = [
  'password',
  'new_password',
  'password_hash',
  'token',
  'secret',
  'smtp_password',
  'api_key',
  'otp',
  'access_token',
  'refresh_token',
];

function isSensitiveKey(key) {
  const lower = key.toLowerCase();
  return SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => lower.includes(pattern));
}

function redactSensitiveData(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return null;
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return obj.map((item) => (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item));
  }

  const sanitized = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (isSensitiveKey(key)) {
      sanitized[key] = '[REDACTED]';
    } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = redactSensitiveData(value);
    } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = value.map((item) =>
        typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item
      );
    } else {
      sanitized[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return sanitized;
}

function computeStructuredDiff(before, after) {
  if (!before && !after) return null;

  const cleanBefore = redactSensitiveData(before);
  const cleanAfter = redactSensitiveData(after);

  if (cleanBefore && cleanAfter) {
    const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(cleanBefore), ...Object.keys(cleanAfter)]));

    const changedBefore = {};
    const changedAfter = {};

    for (const key of allKeys) {
      const bRaw = cleanBefore[key];
      const aRaw = cleanAfter[key];

      const bVal = bRaw !== undefined ? bRaw : null;
      const aVal = aRaw !== undefined ? aRaw : null;

      const bNorm =
        typeof bVal === 'number' || typeof bVal === 'boolean'
          ? String(bVal)
          : typeof bVal === 'string'
          ? bVal.trim()
          : bVal;
      const aNorm =
        typeof aVal === 'number' || typeof aVal === 'boolean'
          ? String(aVal)
          : typeof aVal === 'string'
          ? aVal.trim()
          : aVal;

      if (JSON.stringify(bNorm) !== JSON.stringify(aNorm)) {
        changedBefore[key] = bVal;
        changedAfter[key] = aVal;
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(changedBefore).length === 0) {
      console.warn('[AUDIT ENGINE] No delta detected between before and after objects:', {
        before: cleanBefore,
        after: cleanAfter,
      });
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cleanAfter)) {
        if (k !== 'updated_at' && k !== 'created_at') {
          changedBefore[k] = cleanBefore[k] !== undefined ? cleanBefore[k] : null;
          changedAfter[k] = v;
        }
      }
    }

    return { before: changedBefore, after: changedAfter };
  }

  const single = cleanBefore ? { before: cleanBefore } : cleanAfter ? { after: cleanAfter } : null;
  return single;
}

async function testLabUpdate() {
  console.log('Testing Lab UPDATE in Postgres...');
  // 1. Fetch Chem lab
  const prevRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = 'chem'");
  const beforeLab = prevRes.rows[0];
  console.log('Before Lab capacity:', beforeLab.capacity);

  // New capacity: 55
  const newCapacity = beforeLab.capacity === 50 ? 55 : 50;
  const updateRes = await pool.query(
    "UPDATE public.labs SET capacity = $1 WHERE id = 'chem' RETURNING *",
    [newCapacity]
  );
  const afterLab = updateRes.rows[0];
  console.log('After Lab capacity:', afterLab.capacity);

  const diff = computeStructuredDiff(beforeLab, afterLab);
  console.log('Diff result:', diff);

  // Insert into audit_logs
  const auditRes = await pool.query(
    `
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
      actor_id,
      actor_name,
      actor_role,
      action,
      entity_type,
      entity_id,
      entity_label,
      changes,
      metadata
    ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
    RETURNING *;
    `,
    [
      '1cb09b62-8dd2-445f-b5ae-a186df967cf5',
      'System Administrator',
      'super_admin',
      'UPDATE',
      'lab',
      'chem',
      afterLab.name,
      JSON.stringify(diff),
      JSON.stringify({ operation: 'test_lab_update' }),
    ]
  );
  console.log('Inserted Audit Log for UPDATE:', auditRes.rows[0].id, auditRes.rows[0].changes);

  // Revert capacity back
  await pool.query("UPDATE public.labs SET capacity = $1 WHERE id = 'chem'", [beforeLab.capacity]);
  console.log('Reverted lab capacity.');
}

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

import pg from 'pg';

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function runTests() {
  console.log('--- TEST SUITE: INSTITUTION SETTINGS SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH ---');
  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  function assert(condition, msg) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`✅ PASS: ${msg}`);
      passed++;
    } else {
      console.error(`❌ FAIL: ${msg}`);
      failed++;
    }
  }

  try {
    // 1. Table existence and RLS check
    const rlsRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT rowsecurity FROM pg_tables 
      WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'institution_settings';
    `);
    assert(rlsRes.rows.length === 1, 'Table public.institution_settings exists');
    assert(rlsRes.rows[0]?.rowsecurity === true, 'Row Level Security is enabled on institution_settings');

    // 2. Realtime Publication check
    const pubRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
      WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'institution_settings';
    `);
    assert(pubRes.rows.length === 1, 'institution_settings is published in supabase_realtime publication');

    // 3. Required Institutional Keys check
    const keysRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT key FROM public.institution_settings ORDER BY key;
    `);
    const foundKeys = keysRes.rows.map(r => r.key);
    const expectedKeys = [
      'calendar_settings',
      'infrastructure_classes',
      'infrastructure_incident_categories',
      'infrastructure_incident_settings',
      'infrastructure_periods',
      'infrastructure_subjects',
    ];

    for (const key of expectedKeys) {
      assert(foundKeys.includes(key), `Key "${key}" is stored in PostgreSQL institution_settings`);
    }

    // 4. Verify calendar_settings schema
    const calRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key = 'calendar_settings';
    `);
    const calVal = calRes.rows[0]?.value;
    assert(calVal && typeof calVal === 'object', 'calendar_settings value is a valid JSON object');
    assert('startDay' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains startDay');
    assert('sundayWeekend' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains sundayWeekend');
    assert('saturdayWeekend' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains saturdayWeekend');

    // 5. Verify periods schema
    const perRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key = 'infrastructure_periods';
    `);
    const perVal = perRes.rows[0]?.value;
    assert(Array.isArray(perVal) && perVal.length > 0, 'infrastructure_periods is a non-empty array');
    assert(perVal[0]?.id && perVal[0]?.name && perVal[0]?.label, 'Period item has id, name, label');

    console.log(`\nResults: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed.`);
    if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error running test suite:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function updateTrigger() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🔄 Updating sync_practical_log_attendance trigger to use canonical student_enrollments...')

    const updateSql = `
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_practical_log_attendance()
      RETURNS trigger
      LANGUAGE plpgsql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      AS $function$
      declare
        cs_row record;
        enr_row record;
        is_absent boolean;
      begin
        delete from public.log_attendance where log_id = new.id;

        if new.class_subject_id is not null then
          select academic_year_id, class_id into cs_row
          from public.class_subjects
          where id = new.class_subject_id;

          if found and cs_row.academic_year_id is not null and cs_row.class_id is not null then
            for enr_row in 
              select id as enrollment_id, student_id, roll_number
              from public.student_enrollments
              where academic_year_id = cs_row.academic_year_id
                and class_id = cs_row.class_id
                and status = 'active'
              order by roll_number asc
            loop
              is_absent := (new.absent_rolls is not null and enr_row.roll_number = any(new.absent_rolls));
              insert into public.log_attendance (id, log_id, roll_number, is_present, student_id, enrollment_id, created_at)
              values (
                gen_random_uuid()::text,
                new.id,
                enr_row.roll_number,
                not is_absent,
                enr_row.student_id,
                enr_row.enrollment_id,
                now()
              )
              on conflict (log_id, roll_number) do update set
                is_present = excluded.is_present,
                student_id = excluded.student_id,
                enrollment_id = excluded.enrollment_id;
            end loop;
          end if;
        end if;

        return new;
      end;
      $function$;
    `

    await client.query(updateSql)
    console.log('✅ Trigger function sync_practical_log_attendance updated successfully!')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

updateTrigger().catch(err => {
  console.error('Trigger update failed:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

function renderPrintHtml(records, densityMode) {
  const colDate = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'date');
  const colPeriod = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'period_label');
  const colBatch = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'batch_group');
  const colSubject = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'subject_title');
  const colTopic = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'topic_learned');
  const colTeacher = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'teacher_name');
  const colAttendance = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'attendance');
  const colStatus = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'status');
  const colRemarks = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'remarks');

  const notes = [];
  let rowCounter = 0;

  const rows = records.map((log) => {
    rowCounter++;
    const rowId = `Row #${rowCounter} (${log.date} | ${log.labs?.name || 'Lab'})`;

    let topicDisplay = log.topic_learned || '—';
    let topicFootnoteIdx = null;
    if (log.topic_learned) {
      const maxTopic = colTopic.print[densityMode].maxChars;
      const res = truncateAtWordBoundary(log.topic_learned, maxTopic);
      if (res.truncated) {
        topicFootnoteIdx = notes.length + 1;
        notes.push({
          index: topicFootnoteIdx,
          rowIdentifier: rowId,
          fieldName: 'Topic Learned',
          fullText: log.topic_learned.trim(),
        });
        topicDisplay = res.text;
      }
    }

    const rawRemarks =
      log.status === 'skipped'
        ? log.skip_reason
          ? `Skipped: ${log.skip_reason}`
          : 'Class postponed'
        : log.remarks || 'Standard practical routine executed.';

    let remarksDisplay = rawRemarks;
    let remarksFootnoteIdx = null;
    const maxRemarks = colRemarks.print[densityMode].maxChars;
    const resRemarks = truncateAtWordBoundary(rawRemarks, maxRemarks);
    if (resRemarks.truncated) {
      remarksFootnoteIdx = notes.length + 1;
      notes.push({
        index: remarksFootnoteIdx,
        rowIdentifier: rowId,
        fieldName: log.status === 'skipped' ? 'Skip Reason' : 'Remarks',
        fullText: rawRemarks.trim(),
      });
      remarksDisplay = resRemarks.text;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td style="width: ${colDate.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.date}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colPeriod.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.period_label}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colBatch.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; font-weight: bold;">${log.batch_group}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colSubject.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">
          <strong>${log.subject_name}</strong><br>
          <span style="color: #4b5563;">${log.practical_title}</span>
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colTopic.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; font-style: italic;">
          ${topicDisplay}${topicFootnoteIdx ? ` <sup>[${topicFootnoteIdx}]</sup>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colTeacher.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.profiles.full_name}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colAttendance.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; text-align: center; font-family: monospace;">
          ${log.present_students}/${log.total_students}
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colStatus.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; text-align: center;">
          <span style="font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase;">${log.status}</span>
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colRemarks.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">
          ${remarksDisplay}${remarksFootnoteIdx ? ` <sup>[${remarksFootnoteIdx}]</sup>` : ''}
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  const footnotesHtml = notes.length > 0 ? `
    <div style="margin-top: 15px; border-top: 2px solid #18181b; padding-top: 8px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 8pt; break-inside: avoid;">
      <div style="font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: monospace; margin-bottom: 5px;">
        Audit Trail Footnotes &amp; Extended Narrative Notes (${notes.length} Annotated Records)
      </div>
      ${notes.map(n => `
        <div style="margin-bottom: 3px;">
          <strong style="font-family: monospace;">[${n.index}]</strong>
          <strong>${n.rowIdentifier} — ${n.fieldName}:</strong>
          <span style="font-style: italic;">"${n.fullText}"</span>
        </div>
      `).join('')}
    </div>
  ` : '';

  const isCompact = densityMode === 'compact';

  return {
    notesCount: notes.length,
    html: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
  @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 6mm 8mm; }
  body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; margin: 0; background: white; color: black; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: ${isCompact ? '7.5pt' : '8.5pt'}; }
  th {
    padding: ${isCompact ? '1.5px 3.5px' : '3.5px 5px'};
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: ${isCompact ? '7pt' : '8pt'};
    font-weight: bold;
    height: ${isCompact ? '18px' : '22px'};
  }
  td {
    padding: ${isCompact ? '1.5px 3.5px' : '3.5px 5px'};
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    line-height: ${isCompact ? '1.10' : '1.22'};
    vertical-align: top;
    font-size: ${isCompact ? '7.5pt' : '8.5pt'};
  }
  thead { display: table-header-group !important; }
  tr { break-inside: avoid !important; page-break-inside: avoid !important; }
  .sig-box { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 8px; text-align: center; break-inside: avoid; }
  .sig-line { border-top: 2px solid #18181b; width: 180px; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 3px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8pt; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div style="border-bottom: 2px solid #18181b; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
    <div style="font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; color: #52525b;">NEPAL SECONDARY EDUCATION BOARD • CENTRAL CAMPUS</div>
    <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase;">SHREE RATNA RAJYA LAXMI SECONDARY SCHOOL</div>
    <div style="font-size: 8.5px; color: #52525b;">OFFICIAL PRACTICAL EXPERIMENT &amp; ATTENDANCE AUDIT REGISTER (50 SESSIONS)</div>

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
const dbUrl = content.split('\n').find(l => l.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')).split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function check() {
  const res = await pool.query(`
    SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type 
    FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      AND (
        (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name = 'student_id') OR
        (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
        (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id')
      );
  `)
  console.log('Columns verified:', res.rows)

  const constraintsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT conname, conrelid::regclass, contype
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname IN (

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🛡️ STEP 06: EXECUTING COMPREHENSIVE STOP-GATE VERIFICATION...')

    const res = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schedules WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_schedules,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_logs,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.class_subjects WHERE academic_year_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_assignments;
    `)

    const row = res.rows[0]
    const unlinkedSchedules = parseInt(row.unlinked_schedules, 10)
    const unlinkedLogs = parseInt(row.unlinked_logs, 10)
    const unlinkedAssignments = parseInt(row.unlinked_assignments, 10)

    console.log(`- Unlinked Schedules: ${unlinkedSchedules}`)
    console.log(`- Unlinked Practical Logs: ${unlinkedLogs}`)
    console.log(`- Unlinked Teaching Assignments: ${unlinkedAssignments}`)

    const failures = []
    if (unlinkedSchedules > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedSchedules} unlinked schedules`)
    if (unlinkedLogs > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedLogs} unlinked practical logs`)
    if (unlinkedAssignments > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedAssignments} unlinked assignments`)

    if (failures.length > 0) {
      fs.writeFileSync('scratch/reconciliation-gate-failures.json', JSON.stringify({
        unlinkedSchedules,
        unlinkedLogs,
        unlinkedAssignments,
        failures
      }, null, 2))
      console.error(`❌ STOP-GATE TRIGGERED: Found ${failures.join(', ')}. Halting migration.`)
      process.exit(1)
    }

    console.log('✅ STEP 06 STOP-GATE PASSED! Zero unlinked schedules, logs, and assignments.')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(err => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split('\n')
  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue
    const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
    if (eqIdx === -1) continue
    const k = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim()
    let v = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim()
    if (v.startsWith('"') && v.endsWith('"')) v = v.slice(1, -1)
    if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
  }
}

loadEnv()

=== FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scripts\client-agent\labsync-agent.ps1 ===
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    LabSync LIMS - Native Windows Student Terminal Client Agent
.DESCRIPTION
    Extracts physical workstation hardware telemetry (CPU, RAM, Storage, OS, MAC, LAN IP),
    binds to a 100% unique composite silicon GUID ($regGuid-$macAddr), authenticates with
    the LabSync Next.js server via TOFU (Trust-On-First-Use), and launches a tamper-proof
    browser session.
.PARAMETER ServerUrl
    Optional override URL for the LabSync server.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$ServerUrl = "",
    [string]$StationCode = "",
    [switch]$DebugMode
)

# Set console title & window aesthetics
$Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle = "LabSync Terminal Agent - Workstation Initialization"

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "==========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "      LabSync LIMS - Physical Workstation Client Agent (v1.0.0)           " -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "==========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# 1. Resolve Server URL and Agent Configuration
$scriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$configFile = Join-Path $scriptDir "config.json"
$sampleConfigFile = Join-Path $scriptDir "config.sample.json"

$resolvedServerUrl = $ServerUrl
$resolvedStationCode = $StationCode
$agentKey = ""

if (Test-Path $configFile) {
    try {
        $config = Get-Content $configFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolvedServerUrl) -and $config.server_url) { $resolvedServerUrl = $config.server_url }
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolvedStationCode) -and $config.station_code) { $resolvedStationCode = $config.station_code }
        if ($config.agent_key) { $agentKey = $config.agent_key }
        if ($config.debug) { $DebugMode = $true }
    } catch {
        Write-Host "[!] Warning: Unable to parse config.json. Using defaults." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
}

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolvedServerUrl)) {
    $resolvedServerUrl = "http://localhost:3000"
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolvedStationCode)) {
    $rawName = $env:COMPUTERNAME
    # Normalize common lab hostname formats: e.g. "PC01", "PC-01", "LAB-PC-01", "PC1", "DESK-1" -> "PC-01"
    if ($rawName -match '^(?:.*?(?:PC|DESK|NODE)[-_]?)(\d+)$') {
        $num = [int]$matches[1]
        $resolvedStationCode = "PC-{0:D2}" -f $num
    } elseif ($rawName -match '^[A-Za-z]+[-_]?\d+$') {
        $resolvedStationCode = $rawName.ToUpper()
    } else {
        $resolvedStationCode = $rawName
    }
}

# Remove trailing slash
$resolvedServerUrl = $resolvedServerUrl.TrimEnd('/')

Write-Host "[*] Target LabSync Server : $resolvedServerUrl" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "[*] Station Identifier    : $resolvedStationCode" -ForegroundColor Gray

# 2. Extract Hardware Telemetry & Silicon Identifiers
Write-Host "[+] Querying physical machine telemetry..." -ForegroundColor White

# 2A. Composite Silicon GUID (MachineGuid + MAC Address)
$regGuid = (Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).MachineGuid
if (-not $regGuid) {
    # Fallback if registry key restricted
    $regGuid = [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
}

$activeNic = Get-CimInstance Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | 
    Where-Object { $_.IPEnabled -eq $true } | 
    Select-Object -First 1

$macAddr = if ($activeNic -and $activeNic.MACAddress) { 
    $activeNic.MACAddress.Replace(':', '-') 
} else { 
    "00-00-00-00-00-00" 
}

# 100% Unique Composite Identifier (immune to cloned disk images)
$compositeGuid = "$regGuid-$macAddr"

# 2B. Processor Info
$cpuInfo = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
$cpuName = if ($cpuInfo -and $cpuInfo.Name) { $cpuInfo.Name.Trim() } else { "Intel Core / AMD Processor" }
$cpuCores = if ($cpuInfo -and $cpuInfo.NumberOfCores) { [int]$cpuInfo.NumberOfCores } else { 4 }

# 2C. Memory (RAM)
$rawRamBytes = (Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum).Sum
$ramGb = if ($rawRamBytes) { [math]::Round(($rawRamBytes / 1GB), 1) } else { 8.0 }

# 2D. Primary Storage (Drive C:)
$cDrive = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID='C:'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$diskTotalGb = if ($cDrive -and $cDrive.Size) { [math]::Round(($cDrive.Size / 1GB), 1) } else { 256.0 }
$diskFreeGb = if ($cDrive -and $cDrive.FreeSpace) { [math]::Round(($cDrive.FreeSpace / 1GB), 1) } else { 50.0 }
$diskUsedPct = if ($diskTotalGb -gt 0) { [math]::Round((($diskTotalGb - $diskFreeGb) / $diskTotalGb) * 100, 1) } else { 50.0 }

# 2E. Operating System Details
$osInfo = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$osCaption = if ($osInfo -and $osInfo.Caption) { $osInfo.Caption.Trim() } else { "Microsoft Windows 11" }
$osBuild = if ($osInfo -and $osInfo.BuildNumber) { [string]$osInfo.BuildNumber } else { "22631" }

# 2F. Local IPv4 Address
$lanIp = if ($activeNic -and $activeNic.IPAddress) { $activeNic.IPAddress[0] } else { "127.0.0.1" }

Write-Host "    - Composite GUID : $compositeGuid" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
Write-Host "    - CPU            : $cpuName ($cpuCores Cores)" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "    - Memory         : $ramGb GB RAM" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "    - Storage (C:)   : $diskFreeGb GB Free of $diskTotalGb GB ($diskUsedPct% Used)" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "    - OS Version     : $osCaption (Build $osBuild)" -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host "    - Network Link   : $lanIp ($macAddr)" -ForegroundColor Gray

# 3. Construct Payload
$telemetryPayload = @{
    computer_name  = $resolvedStationCode
    machine_guid   = $compositeGuid
    hardware_specs = @{
        cpu             = $cpuName
        cpu_cores       = $cpuCores
        ram_gb          = $ramGb
        disk_c_total_gb = $diskTotalGb
        disk_c_free_gb  = $diskFreeGb
        disk_c_used_pct = $diskUsedPct
        os_caption      = $osCaption
        os_build        = $osBuild
        mac_address     = $macAddr
        lan_ip          = $lanIp
        agent_version   = "1.0.0"
        last_synced_at  = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
    }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

$handshakeEndpoint = "$resolvedServerUrl/api/terminal/handshake"
$headers = @{
    "Content-Type" = "application/json"
}
if (![string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($agentKey)) {
    $headers["X-LabSync-Agent-Key"] = $agentKey
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[+] Connecting to LabSync Handshake Gateway..." -ForegroundColor White

# 4. Perform Handshake with Offline Diagnostic Fallback
$handshakeSuccess = $false
$redirectUrl = ""

try {
    # Skip TLS certificate validation for local self-signed HTTPS if testing
    [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = { $true }

    $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $handshakeEndpoint -Method Post -Body $telemetryPayload -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 10 -ErrorAction Stop

    if ($response.success -and $response.redirect_url) {
        $handshakeSuccess = $true
        $redirectUrl = $response.redirect_url
        Write-Host "[OK] Machine Handshake Authorized!" -ForegroundColor Green
        Write-Host "    - Bound Station Code : $($response.station_code)" -ForegroundColor Green
        if ($response.is_new_pairing) {
            Write-Host "    - TOFU Status        : New hardware lock established" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        } else {
            Write-Host "    - TOFU Status        : Verified existing hardware lock" -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "[!] Handshake Rejected: $($response.error)" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "==========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  [!] NETWORK UNREACHABLE ON $env:COMPUTERNAME" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "==========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Red

    # Quick Local Diagnostic
    $linkStatus = "Ethernet Link Down / Cable Unplugged"
    try {
        $netAdapters = Get-NetAdapter -Physical -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Up' }
        if ($netAdapters) {
            $linkStatus = "Ethernet Link Up, but Server $resolvedServerUrl Unreachable"
        }
    } catch {}

    Write-Host "  - Detected Status : $linkStatus" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "  - Error Details   : $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "  ACTION REQUIRED:" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  Please notify the Lab In-Charge or Instructor verbally that this desk" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "  has no network connection to the laboratory server." -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "==========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host "Press any key to close this diagnostic window..." -ForegroundColor Gray
    $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey("NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown")
    exit 1
}

# 5. Launch Tamper-Proof Browser Session
if ($handshakeSuccess -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($redirectUrl)) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "[+] Launching Student Terminal Portal in default browser..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "    Target URL: $redirectUrl" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    
    try {
        Start-Process $redirectUrl
    } catch {
        Write-Host "[!] Unable to start default browser: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    }

    if (-not $DebugMode) {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[OK] Workstation initialized. Window closing in 3 seconds..." -ForegroundColor DarkGray
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
    } else {
        Write-Host ""
        Write-Host "[Debug Mode Active] Press any key to exit..." -ForegroundColor Gray
        $null = $Host.UI.RawUI.ReadKey("NoEcho,IncludeKeyDown")
    }
}

@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
title LabSync Client Agent Installer

echo =====================================================================
echo           LabSync LIMS - Client Workstation Agent Setup
echo =====================================================================
echo.

:: 1. Check for Administrator Privileges
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    echo [!] Requesting administrative privileges...
    powershell -Command "Start-Process '%~f0' -Verb RunAs"
    exit /b
)

set "TARGET_DIR=C:\LabSync"

echo [*] Target Installation Directory: %TARGET_DIR%
if not exist "%TARGET_DIR%" (
    echo [+] Creating %TARGET_DIR%...
    mkdir "%TARGET_DIR%"
)

echo [+] Copying agent files...
copy /Y "%~dp0labsync-agent.ps1" "%TARGET_DIR%\labsync-agent.ps1" >nul
if exist "%~dp0config.json" (
    copy /Y "%~dp0config.json" "%TARGET_DIR%\config.json" >nul
) else (
    copy /Y "%~dp0config.sample.json" "%TARGET_DIR%\config.json" >nul
)

:: 2. Register Silent Windows Scheduled Task at Logon / Boot
echo [+] Registering background startup task "LabSyncClientAgent"...
schtasks /delete /tn "LabSyncClientAgent" /f >nul 2>&1
schtasks /create /tn "LabSyncClientAgent" /tr "powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File \"%TARGET_DIR%\labsync-agent.ps1\"" /sc onlogon /rl highest /f >nul

if %errorlevel% equ 0 (
    echo     [OK] Background startup task registered (Runs on every student logon/boot).
) else (
    echo     [!] Warning: Could not register scheduled task. Agent can still run via shortcut.
)

:: 3. Create Desktop Shortcut "LabSync Student Portal"
echo [+] Creating Desktop Shortcut "LabSync Student Portal"...
set "SHORTCUT_PATH=%PUBLIC%\Desktop\LabSync Student Portal.lnk"
set "VBS_SCRIPT=%TEMP%\create_shortcut.vbs"

echo Set oWS = WScript.CreateObject("WScript.Shell") > "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo sLinkFile = "%SHORTCUT_PATH%" >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo Set oLink = oWS.CreateShortcut(sLinkFile) >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.TargetPath = "powershell.exe" >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.Arguments = "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File """ ^& "%TARGET_DIR%\labsync-agent.ps1" ^& """" >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.WorkingDirectory = "%TARGET_DIR%" >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.Description = "Launch LabSync Student Terminal Portal" >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.WindowStyle = 1 >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"
echo oLink.Save >> "%VBS_SCRIPT%"

cscript /nologo "%VBS_SCRIPT%" >nul 2>&1
del "%VBS_SCRIPT%" >nul 2>&1

echo.
echo =====================================================================
echo [OK] Setup Completed Successfully!
echo      - Program Folder : %TARGET_DIR%
echo      - Auto-Start     : Enabled (Windows Scheduled Task on Logon/Boot)
echo      - Public Desktop : "LabSync Student Portal"
echo =====================================================================
echo.
timeout /t 5

'use client'

import * as React from 'react'
import { ThemeProvider as NextThemesProvider } from 'next-themes'

// Suppress known false-positive React 19 script tag warning from next-themes in development
if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
  const origError = typeof console !== 'undefined' ? console.error : undefined
  if (typeof origError === 'function') {
    console.error = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      if (
        typeof args[0] === 'string' &&
        args[0].includes('Encountered a script tag while rendering React component')
      ) {
        return
      }
      try {
        origError.apply(console, args)
      } catch {
        // Fallback safely
      }
    }
  }
}

export default function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <NextThemesProvider
      attribute="class"
      defaultTheme="system"
      enableSystem
      disableTransitionOnChange
    >
      {children}
    </NextThemesProvider>
  )
}
